text:
# Toyota_Service_Booking_Agent: a new service booking, from the car to the confirmation
# (journey 05, "Book A Service"). Toyota_Supervisor hands the caller over once the caller and the
# car are settled: the caller, the car, the four vehicle facts and the caller's own name arrive
# with the handoff, so no car is looked up or asked for here. Phases: 1 the car as it arrives,
# 2 existing booking and routing table, 3 what the car needs, 4 the service centre, 5 the day
# and time, 6 read-back, booking and confirmation.
# Covers 49 cases:
#   The car
#   C2   (E58) non-GCC car: not booked; details emailed to the Auto Center, its toll-free number given [open]
#   E54  spells out an email address: no email on the call, the message carries the link
#   E52  the car already has a future booking: read out, offer to change it, one booking per car
#   E56  guest with a booking for that car: duplicate check by plate and phone before the centre
#   E57  GCC car bought outside Al-Futtaim: the regular 10K service only
#   E59b leased car: passed to a person until agreed [open]
#   K12b wants the car in their name: owner change explained, service booked if wanted [open]
#   What the car needs
#   Q10  (E62, E47) warranty or recall visit: record checked, safety recall to the centre now,
#        running recall booked, otherwise an enquiry; warranty dates with the centre-confirms note [open]
#   P03  mileage differs or caller not sure: next service from the history, caller's mileage,
#        last visit's mileage as a hint, then an Unsure KM note; price only if asked
#   E63  prepaid service contract: "Your 40,000 km service is already paid"
#   E65  past the due mileage: "the 50,000 or the 60,000?"
#   E66  mileage not known: asked once, then a No Mileage note
#   E67  next service not due yet: the interval and the next date
#   E69  concern that is safe to drive: goes in the booking notes
#   E70  second car in the same call: the first is finished, then the next starts
#   N16  only tyres, a battery or an AC check: a visit with the job added [open]
#   N18  registration blocked for an open recall: like any recall booking; already done: visit the centre [open]
#   N19  speed limit certificate: centre checked for it, booked with a note [open]
#   The service centre
#   E74  (K10) car or job that only some centres take: capable centres only, nearest first [open]
#   K05  Supra: only where it is taken, for the next service in its history
#   K06  smart repair, polish, detailing or tint: not on the days the centre excludes [open]
#   E75  (K03, E101) pick-up and drop-off: offered on every booking, added if accepted [open]
#   K07  key drop after hours: only where the centre has it [open]
#   K08  shuttle: per centre, from the centre data [open]
#   C5   express service: only where it is offered, for a regular service
#   E76  preferred service advisor: added when the customer asks
#   E71  same centre as last time: the last centre from the service history
#   E72  names a place, not a centre: area worked out, emirate asked only if unclear
#   E73  Supra or 86 at a centre that cannot service it: the centres that can
#   E77  wants to wait at the centre: noted on the booking
#   N03  limo: not booked; the branch is emailed and calls back
#   The day and time
#   Q05  preferred slot not free: nearest time, another day, another centre, up to 3 options, plus
#        early key drop or pick-up and drop-off; all refused: branch emailed, branch calls back
#   C3   (E81) service today: free slot at least 2 hours ahead at any branch, branch emailed in
#        every outcome; under 2 hours: walk-in suggested
#   Q12  "can I just walk in": booking options first, walk-in only as the last resort
#   E78  "Thursday at 2": live slots, read back as "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm"
#   E79  time taken: nearest time that day, then another day, then another centre
#   E80  weekend and Sunday full: Saturday
#   E82  "Thursday" when today is Thursday: today, or next Thursday the 8th?
#   E83  "after work", "tomorrow morning": a time window, first slot in it
#   E84  nothing soon enough: days and centres widened once, then a person
#   E85  slot goes while booking: held once picked, one more search
#   N02  public holiday: holiday list checked before any slot is offered
#   Book and confirm
#   K11  booked online and calls straight after: bookings checked directly before booking again
#   Q08  (E43) confirmation SMS to the registered number, last digits confirmed, or to another
#        number; the centre's location and hours by WhatsApp with SMS as the backup [open]
#   E86  changes something at the read-back: back to that step, then read back again
#   E88  SMS does not arrive: the read-back is the backup, the message is sent again
#   E89  wants the confirmation by email: no email, the link in the message
#   N24  call drops halfway: nothing booked before the read-back, offer to finish where it stopped [open]
#   N01  booking fails or errors: checked whether it went through before trying again, then a person
# Handed back to the supervisor with __return_to_parent__: changes to a booking that exists
# (journey 06, including a late pick-up cancellation and its fee from K03), body shop cases,
# status and general questions.
# Environment flags read here (unset means the interim behaviour of the use-case document):
#   TOYOTA_NON_GCC_MODE                     "transfer": a non-GCC car goes to a person, no Auto Center email (C2)
#   TOYOTA_LEASED_CAR_MODE                  "book": a leased car is booked like any other car (E59b)
#   TOYOTA_RECALL_BOOK_RUNNING              "false": a running recall is an enquiry to the centre, not a booking (Q10)
#   TOYOTA_RTA_RECALL_BLOCK_ENABLED         "false": a registration block for a recall goes to a person (N18)
#   TOYOTA_JOB_ONLY_VISIT_ENABLED           "false": a visit for one job without a service goes to a person (N16)
#   TOYOTA_SPEED_LIMIT_CERTIFICATE_ENABLED  "false": a speed limit certificate goes to a person (N19)
#   TOYOTA_PUDO_OFFER_EVERY_BOOKING         "false": pick-up and drop-off is added only when the caller asks (E75)
#   TOYOTA_BOOKING_RESUME_ENABLED           "false": an unfinished booking from an earlier call is not offered (N24)
#   TOYOTA_BOOKING_CONFIRMATION_CHANNEL     "whatsapp": the confirmation goes by WhatsApp, with SMS as the backup (Q08)
#   TOYOTA_LOCATIONS_MESSAGE_CHANNEL        "sms": the centre's location and hours go by SMS only (Q08; the same
#                                           flag as in the locations agent)
#   TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE                        "true": the outcome line calls the booking a demonstration booking
#                                           (E121, journey 09; the project's demo flag, not a flag of this agent)
# The centre data behind K06, K07, K08, E74 and E75 comes from the centre search and the slot
# search: it is data, not a flag.
# Leaving the flow: a finished request closes its own turn in one of two fixed steps, closing
# (the shared line "Is there anything else I can help you with?") or next_car_offer (E70: the
# offer to book the other car), and completes there. A safety or person handover is made by
# the two hand-off steps at the end (safety_handoff, person_handoff), in the step that raises
# the flag, never by completing.
# Order of speech (contract v2, section 2): whatever has to be heard before a fixed line is
# itself said by a fixed step. The outcome of a request to a team is worded by request_tell,
# which writes it and says nothing, and said by request_say; the warranty dates are worded by
# warranty_tell and said by warranty_say in the same way. The model says nothing before
# any hand-over; before a hand-over that the flow itself decides, the caller hears one fixed
# line (person_line), and the agent that takes over speaks after it.
# What arrives (contract v2, section 2): the car is booked by its vehicle record id only when
# its record status says it is on the profile in use. For record status not_in_callers_name
# or not_found the car is booked by plate and model, and for a guest no profile is used,
# whatever else arrived with the handoff (car_record_gate and the steps after it).
# Returned to the supervisor: car_settled. It arrives true and is set to false when a booking
# is made and when the request turns out to be about another car, so the next booking request
# goes through the identity agent, which asks which car (E70). Every other exit leaves it as
# it arrived, so a caller who digresses comes back to the same booking.
AGENT: Toyota_Service_Booking_Agent
VERSION: "0.2.0"
DESCRIPTION: "Books a new Toyota service visit, from the car to the confirmation message"

GOAL: |
  Book one new service visit for the caller's Toyota, from the car to the confirmation. Make sure
  the car can be booked on this call and has no booking already, agree what it needs, the service
  centre, the day and the time from live availability, read everything back, and only after a
  clear yes make the booking and send the confirmation message. When a rule says the visit
  cannot be booked here, pass the request to the right team or to a person with a full summary.

PERSONA: |
  You are the Toyota voice assistant for Al-Futtaim in the UAE, booking a service visit on the
  phone. Warm, brief and clear: one question at a time, two short sentences at most. You answer
  in the language the caller is speaking, English or Gulf Arabic, and keep everything agreed.

LIMITATIONS:
  - "Book one new service visit for one car at a time. A request to confirm, change or cancel a booking that already exists, a workshop or body shop status, a general question or a sales question is not yours: hand it back with the __return_to_parent__ tool and add nothing about it."
  - "Nothing is booked until the caller has confirmed the read-back. Never say or imply that a visit is booked, or that a message has been sent: fixed steps tell the caller that, once the booking system and the message service have confirmed it."
  - "One booking per car. Never offer or make a second booking for a car that already has a future booking."
  - "No email on this call: never ask for, take or promise an email address, also not for the confirmation. Say that the confirmation message carries a link to add the booking to the calendar, reschedule, cancel or track it."
  - "Give a price only when the caller asks and only for the scheduled service. While the service is being agreed, set price_asked to true and the price is looked up for you; at any other point hand the price question back with the __return_to_parent__ tool. Extra work is added without a price. Never quote a final bill and never promise how long the visit takes: the service advisor confirms those."
  - "Give a warranty date only with the note that the service centre confirms what is covered. Never say a repair is covered."
  - "Never read out the service history or invoices. The last visit's mileage and the last centre are the only history details you may mention."
  - "Offer only centres returned by the centre search for this car and this job, and only times returned by the slot search. Never invent a centre, a time, a phone number, an address, opening hours, a fee or an offer: those come from the tools and the knowledge base."
  - "Offer a walk-in only as the last resort, after the booking options have been tried."
  - "Never list the caller's cars, never mention another brand, and never mention profiles, lookups, systems, tools or agents."
  - "Safety first. If the caller mentions a warning light, a leak, smoke, a noise, a brake or steering problem, or says they are afraid to drive, ask one question: is the car safe to drive? Safe and they simply want it looked at: add it to caller_notes and carry on. Not safe, unsure or afraid: set safety_note to what they reported and what they answered about driving the car, in their words, and safety_flag to true. The word roadside, an accident, an injury, or a child or pet locked in the car: set safety_note and safety_flag at once and ask nothing."
  - "If the caller asks for a person, or is upset or complaining, set handover_reason to caller_asked or caller_upset, then handover_summary (two or three sentences: who is calling, what they wanted, what was done, what is still needed), then needs_person to true."
  - "When you set safety_flag or needs_person, say nothing in that turn: do not apologise, do not announce a transfer and do not promise a person. Whoever takes over speaks next and says what happens. Do not carry on with the booking in that turn."
  - "Never ask for a detail the caller has already given on this call. When the caller's answer completes a step, or its goal is already met, record the result and say nothing: the next step does the talking."
  - "If a search you run yourself fails, run it once more. If it fails again, set handover_reason to system_unavailable, then handover_summary, then needs_person to true."
  - "If the caller says they no longer want a booking or a callback at all, set booking_declined to true and say nothing: the next step tells them that nothing has been booked."
  - "The car for this booking is settled: never ask which car or for the plate. If the caller says this booking should be for a different car, set booking_declined and another_car_pending to true and say nothing: the next step offers the other car."
  - "A number already on file is never read out: say only its last three digits. A number the caller has just given is read back in full, in groups, and used only after a yes."
  - "The caller may add any of these at any point; record it without asking twice: a preferred service advisor, only if they ask for one (preferred_advisor); that they will wait at the centre (customer_waits true); an extra job to add without a price, such as tyres or a battery (extra_jobs); a concern that is safe to drive or a key drop after hours (caller_notes); pick-up and drop-off accepted or declined (pickup_dropoff, and pudo_answered true) and the collection address when they give one (pickup_address); another car to book after this one (another_car_pending true); the centre's location by message (location_requested true)."

LANGUAGE: "en"

# max_flow_iterations is the documented platform default, stated because this flow is made of
# many small fixed steps and the count runs over the whole booking, not per caller turn: a
# plain booking enters about 75 of them, one with a change at the read-back or a lost slot
# about 100 to 110, and one guide quotes a default of 100.
EXECUTION:
  temperature: 0.1
  max_reasoning_iterations: 5
  max_flow_iterations: 1500
  tool_timeout: 8000

USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: toyota_voice
USE BEHAVIOR_PROFILE: ai_summit_demo

MESSAGES:
  filler_general: "One moment please."
  filler_general_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_tool_call: "One moment please."
  filler_tool_call_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."
  filler_handoff: "One moment please."
  filler_handoff_ar: "لحظة من فضلكم."

MEMORY:
  session:
    # Shared session contract: passed in by the supervisor. Who is calling, which car this is
    # and the vehicle facts are settled before this agent starts: the model cannot change them.
    - NAME: caller_phone
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: identity_status
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: crm_customer_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: customer_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: caller_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
      DESCRIPTION: "The caller's own name as they gave it: a driver, someone calling for the owner, a guest"
    - NAME: contact_mobile
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Mobile number the confirmation message goes to, international format"
    - NAME: vehicle_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: plate_number
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_model
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Toyota model of the car. Asked for only when the car is not on file"
    - NAME: vehicle_spec_region
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_ownership_type
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim
      TYPE: boolean
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: vehicle_record_status
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    # Returned to the supervisor: true on arrival, false once a booking is made or the request
    # turns out to be about another car (E70).
    - NAME: car_settled
      TYPE: boolean
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: safety_flag
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: safety_note
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: safety_outcome
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: needs_person
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: handover_reason
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: handover_summary
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: handover_queue
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "toyota_service"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_reference
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: service_code
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: service_label
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_held
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_hold_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_created
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    # Phase 1: the car.
    - NAME: car_issue
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "none"
      DESCRIPTION: "none, limo, imported, leased, owner_change, other_car or record_problem"
    - NAME: regular_service_only
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: leased_allowed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: owner_change_explained
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: owner_change_facts
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_blocked
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booked_for_owner
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booked_by_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    # Phase 2 and 3: existing booking, unfinished draft, what the car needs.
    - NAME: existing_outcome
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "pending"
      DESCRIPTION: "pending, keep, not_this_car or resend_sms"
    - NAME: existing_restricted
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: resume_choice
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "pending"
      DESCRIPTION: "pending, continue or restart. The flow itself sets restored or started"
    - NAME: draft_stage
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "open"
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: visit_type
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "unknown"
      DESCRIPTION: "unknown, service, recall, warranty, job_only, speed_limit_certificate or confirmation_resend"
    - NAME: booking_visit_type
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: express_requested
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: job_capability
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "regular"
      DESCRIPTION: "Capability the centre needs for the job: regular, express, smart_repair or speed_limit_certificate"
    - NAME: extra_jobs
      TYPE: array
      DESCRIPTION: "Jobs to add without a price, for example tyres, battery, AC check"
    - NAME: caller_notes
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      DESCRIPTION: "Notes for the centre in short sentences: a concern that is safe to drive, a key drop after hours, a time wish for the collection"
    - NAME: job_note
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: concern_note
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: record_note
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: ""
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: rta_block_mentioned
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: said_place
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Place, landmark or centre the caller has mentioned, in their words"
    - NAME: said_when
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Day or time the caller has asked for, in their words"
    - NAME: mileage_status
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "pending"
      DESCRIPTION: "pending, given, unsure, unsure_final or unknown"
    - NAME: booking_mileage
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: current_km
      TYPE: number
    - NAME: hint_given
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: service_agreed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: alternative_chosen
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "True when the caller chooses the second of the two services offered"
    - NAME: service_from_list
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: service_by_advisor
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: price_asked
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "True when the caller asks the price of the scheduled service"
    - NAME: price_known
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: price_missing
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: quoted_price_aed
      TYPE: number
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: price_note_centre
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: booking_declined
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: open_recalls
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: open_safety_recall
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: open_bookable_recall
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: recall_ids_to_book
      TYPE: array
      READONLY: true
    # Phase 4: the service centre and what goes with the visit.
    - NAME: selected_centre_id
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: selected_centre_name
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: alternate_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Next nearest centre in the search results that can also do the job"
    - NAME: search_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_centre_id
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_centre_name
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: last_centre_checked
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: chosen_centre
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: other_centre
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: centre_reject_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: pickup_dropoff
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: pudo_answered
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: pudo_unavailable
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: express_unavailable
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: pickup_address
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Address to collect the car from, as the caller gave it"
    - NAME: preferred_advisor
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: customer_waits
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: location_requested
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: another_car_pending
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: walk_in_asked
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    # Phase 5: the day and time.
    - NAME: today_date
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: today_weekday
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: now_time
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: requested_date
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Day the caller wants, as YYYY-MM-DD"
    - NAME: window_start
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Start of the time window as HH:MM, 24-hour"
    - NAME: window_end
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "End of the time window as HH:MM, 24-hour"
    - NAME: fallback_date
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "The other day to try, as YYYY-MM-DD"
    - NAME: search_until_date
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Last day of the holiday check, as YYYY-MM-DD"
    - NAME: same_day_request
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: same_day_too_soon
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
    - NAME: weekend_request
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      DESCRIPTION: "True when the caller asked for a weekend, so the other day to try is the other weekend day"
    - NAME: requested_day_free
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: holidays_checked
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: requested_holiday
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_outcome
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "pending"
      DESCRIPTION: "pending, picked, new_request, change_centre, not_soon_enough or refused"
    - NAME: selected_slot_id
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "slot_id of the chosen slot, copied exactly from the search result"
    - NAME: selected_slot_start
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "start_time of the chosen slot, copied exactly from the search result"
    - NAME: selected_slot_label
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "start_label of the chosen slot, copied exactly from the search result"
    - NAME: picked_wanted
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: picked_that_day
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: picked_other_day
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: picked_other_centre
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: widen_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: slot_research_count
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    # Phase 6: read-back, booking, confirmation, requests to teams.
    - NAME: booking_contact_name
      TYPE: string
    - NAME: contact_last_digits
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: readback_outcome
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "pending"
      DESCRIPTION: "pending, confirmed, change_time, change_centre or change_service"
    - NAME: readback_confirmed
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: readback_bounces
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: create_attempts
      TYPE: number
      INITIAL: 0
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: create_errored
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: own_booking
      TYPE: object
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: confirmation_sent
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: location_sent
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: call_language
      TYPE: string
      INITIAL: "en"
      DESCRIPTION: "en or ar: the language the caller is speaking"
    - NAME: request_team
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_type
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_needs_centre
      TYPE: boolean
      INITIAL: false
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_summary
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "Two or three sentences for the team that receives the request"
    - NAME: request_reply
      TYPE: string
      READONLY: true
    - NAME: request_outcome_line
      TYPE: string
      DESCRIPTION: "What the caller is told after a request went to a team: at most two short sentences in the caller's language, worded exactly as they are to be said on the phone"
    - NAME: warranty_line
      TYPE: string

  # OPEN N24 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call?
  # A small draft per caller, kept for a day (how long is not agreed), so a dropped call can be
  # finished. It is replaced by a plate-only entry once the booking is made or declined.
  persistent:
    - PATH: user.toyota_booking_draft
      SCOPE: user
      ACCESS: readwrite
      TYPE: object
      DESCRIPTION: "Unfinished service booking: what was agreed before the call ended"
  remember:
    - WHEN: service_agreed == true AND booking_created != true AND booking_declined != true
      STORE: {draft_stage, plate_number, visit_type, booking_visit_type, service_code, service_label, job_capability, express_requested, extra_jobs, current_km, mileage_status, booking_mileage, job_note, caller_notes, recall_ids_to_book, selected_centre_id, selected_centre_name} -> user.toyota_booking_draft
      TTL: "24h"
    - WHEN: booking_created == true OR booking_declined == true
      STORE: {plate_number} -> user.toyota_booking_draft
      TTL: "24h"
  recall:
    - ON: agent:Toyota_Service_Booking_Agent:before
      ACTION: inject_context
      PATHS: [user.toyota_booking_draft]

TOOLS:
  find_service_bookings(customer_id?: string, plate_number?: string, mobile_number?: string, booking_reference?: string) -> {total: number, bookings: {booking_reference: string, plate_number: string, vehicle_model: string, centre_id: string, centre_name: string, start_time: string, start_label: string, minutes_until_start: number, can_change: boolean, service_code: string, service_label: string, extra_jobs: string[], notes: string, current_km: number, preferred_advisor: string, channel: string, status: string, customer_name: string, belongs_to_customer_id: string, booked_by_name: string, contact_name: string, contact_mobile: string, is_recall: boolean, pickup_dropoff: boolean}[]}
    description: "Find service bookings from every channel by booking reference, plate, mobile or customer. Returns bookings from the start of today, including a booking for a car that is in the workshop today and missed ones. status is one of confirmed (still to come), in_workshop (the car is at the centre today), missed (the time passed and the car did not come). Cancelled bookings, and bookings whose car has been collected, are not returned. All filters given must match; for a duplicate check pass the plate only. Use before booking to prevent a duplicate, before retrying a failed booking, and to find the booking a caller wants to confirm, change or cancel. start_label is the start time in words, for the read-back. minutes_until_start counts from now and is negative once the time has passed. can_change is true while the booking can still be changed or cancelled, per current policy. channel is one of phone, whatsapp, website, branch. customer_name and belongs_to_customer_id say whose booking it is; booked_by_name is the person who made it for them, or empty."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      customer_id:
        description: "Customer profile identifier from lookup_customer_by_phone or search_customer"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car, as confirmed with the caller"
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number on the booking, E.164"
      booking_reference:
        description: "Booking reference from the confirmation SMS: the DBM or service order number"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.customer_id != "" || params.plate_number != "" || params.mobile_number != "" || params.booking_reference != ""
        on_fail: block("A booking reference, a plate, a mobile number or a customer is needed to find a booking.")
    on_result:
      set:
        existing_booking_count: result.total
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, bookings[].booking_reference, bookings[].plate_number, bookings[].vehicle_model, bookings[].centre_id, bookings[].centre_name, bookings[].start_time, bookings[].start_label, bookings[].minutes_until_start, bookings[].can_change, bookings[].service_code, bookings[].service_label, bookings[].extra_jobs, bookings[].preferred_advisor, bookings[].status, bookings[].booked_by_name, bookings[].is_recall, bookings[].pickup_dropoff]

  get_service_recommendation(vehicle_id: string, current_km?: number, requested_service_km?: number) -> {next_service_code: string, next_service_label: string, next_service_km: number, interval_km: number, next_due_date: string, is_due: boolean, alternative_service_code: string, alternative_service_label: string, requested_service_code: string, requested_service_label: string, last_visit_km: number, last_visit_date: string, last_service_centre_id: string, covered_by_prepaid_contract: boolean}
    description: "Work out which service the car needs next from its service history and, when given, the caller's mileage. Returns the next service, the alternative when the car is past the due mileage, the interval and next date when it is not due yet, the last visit's mileage and centre, and whether a prepaid service contract already covers it. When the caller names a service by its mileage, pass requested_service_km: requested_service_code and requested_service_label are that service, and are empty when it is not given or no service exists at that mileage."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      vehicle_id:
        description: "Vehicle identifier from get_customer_vehicles or find_vehicle"
      current_km:
        description: "Mileage the caller gave, in kilometres. Leave empty when the caller does not know it"
      requested_service_km:
        description: "Mileage of the service the caller named, in kilometres, for example 40000 for the 40,000 km service"
    on_result:
      set:
        recommended_service_code: result.next_service_code
        recommended_service_label: result.next_service_label
        service_is_due: result.is_due
        service_prepaid: result.covered_by_prepaid_contract

  list_service_types(vehicle_model: string, model_year?: number, current_km?: number) -> {total: number, recommended_service_code: string, services: {service_code: string, label: string, due_km: number, is_regular_periodic: boolean}[]}
    description: "List the scheduled services for a Toyota model. Use only when the car is not on file or was bought outside Al-Futtaim, to get a valid service code for the booking. recommended_service_code is the service that fits current_km, and is empty when no mileage is given. is_regular_periodic marks the regular services by mileage."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      vehicle_model:
        description: "Toyota model name as the caller gave it, for example Corolla"
      model_year:
        description: "Model year as four digits, when the caller knows it"
      current_km:
        description: "Mileage the caller gave, in kilometres. Leave empty when the caller does not know it"
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, recommended_service_code, services[].service_code, services[].label, services[].due_km, services[].is_regular_periodic]

  get_service_price(service_code: string, vehicle_id?: string, vehicle_model?: string, include_price?: boolean) -> {price_aed: number, includes: string[], price_valid_until: string}
    description: "Get what one scheduled service includes and, when asked for, its price. Call only when the caller asks the price or what the service includes. Give vehicle_id when the car is on file, otherwise vehicle_model. price_aed is 0 unless include_price is true. With vehicle_model alone the tool returns what the service includes; whether a price can be given without the car record is per current policy. Never use it to price extra work."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      service_code:
        description: "Service code from get_service_recommendation or list_service_types, for example SVC_40K"
      vehicle_id:
        description: "Vehicle identifier from get_customer_vehicles or find_vehicle, when the car is on file"
      vehicle_model:
        description: "Toyota model name, used when there is no vehicle_id"
      include_price:
        description: "True only when the caller asked the price. Otherwise price_aed is 0"

  get_open_recalls(vehicle_id: string) -> {total: number, open_total: number, registration_blocked: boolean, recalls: {recall_id: string, category: string, title: string, completed: boolean, bookable: boolean}[]}
    description: "Check the car record for recall campaigns and whether each one is already done. total counts every campaign on the record; open_total counts those not completed. category is safety or running. Also reports a registration renewal block caused by an open recall."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      vehicle_id:
        description: "Vehicle identifier from get_customer_vehicles or find_vehicle"
    on_result:
      set:
        open_recall_count: result.open_total

  get_warranty_status(vehicle_id: string) -> {in_warranty: boolean, warranty_end_date: string, extended_warranty_end_date: string, extension_eligible: boolean, extension_options: {years: number, cover: string, price_aed: number}[]}
    description: "Get the warranty end date for a car and, when eligible, the one-year and two-year extension prices by cover. Give the date only: the service centre confirms whether a repair is covered."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      vehicle_id:
        description: "Vehicle identifier from get_customer_vehicles or find_vehicle"

  get_last_service_visit(plate_number?: string, vehicle_id?: string) -> {found: boolean, centre_id: string, centre_name: string, visit_date: string, service_advisor_name: string, booking_reference: string}
    description: "Get the last service visit of a car: the centre, the date, the service advisor and the booking reference. Use it to note the last visit on a request to the service advisor and to give that request a centre. Give the plate or the vehicle_id. It is the only part of the service history a tool returns. When the car is unknown or has no visit on record, found is false."
    auth_profile: "toyota_sap_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate as confirmed with the caller: emirate, code and number, for example Dubai A 12345"
      vehicle_id:
        description: "Vehicle identifier from get_customer_vehicles or find_vehicle, when the car is on file"
    process:
      before:
        require:
          - params.plate_number != "" || params.vehicle_id != ""
        on_fail: block("A plate or a vehicle identifier is needed to read the last visit.")

  find_service_centres(area_or_landmark?: string, emirate?: string, centre_name?: string, capability?: string, vehicle_model?: string, open_now?: boolean, limit?: number) -> {total: number, area_resolved: string, emirate_needed: boolean, nearest_centre_id: string, nearest_centre_name: string, centres: {centre_id: string, name: string, emirate: string, area: string, phone: string, open_now: boolean, capabilities: string[], express_service: boolean, key_drop: boolean, shuttle: string, open_sunday: boolean, pickup_dropoff: boolean, free_collection_offer: string}[]}
    description: "Find Toyota service centres, nearest first, for a place, landmark, emirate or centre name. Place names can be given in English or Arabic. Filters to centres that can do the job or take the car: capability is one of regular, express, hybrid, electric, gr, commercial, coaster, supra, body_shop, smart_repair, speed_limit_certificate, emergency_walkin. With open_now true only centres that are open at this moment are returned. emirate_needed is true when the place is unclear and the emirate must be asked. nearest_centre_id and nearest_centre_name repeat the first centre returned. shuttle and free_collection_offer are given in words, per current policy, and are empty when there is none. Never offer a centre that this tool did not return for the requested capability."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      area_or_landmark:
        description: "Place the caller named, in English or Arabic, for example Global Village, Al Quoz or near Mall of the Emirates"
      emirate:
        description: "Emirate name in English, for example Dubai or Sharjah, asked only when the place is unclear"
      centre_name:
        description: "Centre the caller named, for example Al Badia, SZR or Wave, when they ask for a centre and not a place"
      capability:
        description: "Work the centre must be able to do, from the list in the description"
      vehicle_model:
        description: "Model of the car, used to exclude centres that cannot service it, for example Supra or 86"
      open_now:
        description: "True to return only centres that are open at this moment, for example for an emergency walk-in"
      limit:
        description: "Most centres to return, nearest first. Leave empty for all"
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, area_resolved, emirate_needed, nearest_centre_id, nearest_centre_name, centres[].centre_id, centres[].name, centres[].emirate, centres[].area, centres[].phone, centres[].open_now, centres[].express_service, centres[].key_drop, centres[].shuttle, centres[].open_sunday, centres[].pickup_dropoff, centres[].free_collection_offer]

  get_local_date_time() -> {date: string, weekday: string, time: string, iso_datetime: string}
    description: "Get today's date, weekday and time in the UAE. Call it before working out a day from words such as today, tomorrow, Thursday or next Thursday, so that the date comes from a fact. date is YYYY-MM-DD, time is HH:MM, iso_datetime is ISO 8601 with +04:00, and weekday is one of monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never

  get_public_holidays(from_date: date, to_date: date) -> {holidays: {date: string, name: string, centres_closed: boolean}[]}
    description: "List public holidays and special closing days in a date range. Check before offering any slot."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      from_date:
        description: "First date of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, already resolved from what the caller said"
      to_date:
        description: "Last date of the range, YYYY-MM-DD. The same as from_date for one day"

  search_service_slots(centre_id: string, date: date, window_start?: string, window_end?: string, service_code?: string, express?: boolean, job_type?: string, near_time?: string, limit?: number) -> {total: number, centre_id: string, date: string, slots: {slot_id: string, start_time: string, start_label: string, advisor_name: string}[], next_available_date: string}
    description: "Read the live free service slots at one centre on one date, optionally inside a time window. Always call this before offering or confirming a time. Slots less than two hours ahead are never returned. near_time puts the slots closest to that time first, and limit caps how many come back. job_type leaves out days on which the centre does not take that job. start_label is the start time in words, for the read-back. When nothing is free, total is 0 and next_available_date is the next date that has a slot; otherwise next_available_date is empty."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: read_only
    confirm: never
    params:
      centre_id:
        description: "Service centre identifier from find_service_centres, or the centre_id of the booking being moved"
      date:
        description: "Date to search, YYYY-MM-DD, already resolved from what the caller said"
      window_start:
        description: "Start of the caller's preferred window as HH:MM, for example 17:00 for after work"
      window_end:
        description: "End of the caller's preferred window as HH:MM"
      service_code:
        description: "Service code from get_service_recommendation or list_service_types, so the slot length matches the job"
      express:
        description: "True when the caller wants express service"
      job_type:
        description: "Job the visit is for, from the capability list of find_service_centres, for example smart_repair"
      near_time:
        description: "Time the caller asked for as HH:MM. The slots closest to it are returned first"
      limit:
        description: "Most slots to return. Leave empty for all"
    MODEL_CONTEXT:
      FIELDS: [total, date, slots[].slot_id, slots[].start_time, slots[].start_label, slots[].advisor_name, next_available_date]

  hold_service_slot(slot_id: string, plate_number: string) -> {held: boolean, hold_id: string, expires_in_seconds: number, failure_reason: string}
    description: "Hold a slot for a short time as soon as the caller picks it, so it cannot go to someone else during the read-back. The hold ends by itself after expires_in_seconds. Holding the same slot again for the same plate succeeds and returns the hold that already exists. Pass hold_id to create_service_booking or update_service_booking. When held is false, failure_reason is slot_taken or slot_closed; it is empty on success."
    auth_profile: "toyota_booking_api"
    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      slot_id:
        description: "Slot identifier from search_service_slots that the caller picked"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car being booked, as confirmed with the caller"
    on_result:
      set:
        slot_held: result.held
        slot_hold_id: result.hold_id

To change centre, pass replaces_booking_reference: the old booking is cancelled in the same transaction. The notes carry concerns, driver details and anything the centre must know. When pick-up and drop-off is accepted, the centre arranges the chauffeur after the call. status is confirmed when booked is true, and start_label is the booked time in words. When booked is false, failure_reason is one of slot_taken, hold_expired, duplicate_booking, not_allowed, validation; it is empty on success. The booking system sends no SMS: send the confirmation with send_customer_message."

    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      slot_id:

        description: "Plate confirmed with the caller"

      hold_id:
        description: "hold_id returned by hold_service_slot for this slot"

        description: "Booking notes for the service centre"

      express:
        description: "True when the caller wants express service"
      preferred_advisor:
        description: "Service advisor the caller asked for, by name"
      pickup_dropoff:
        description: "True when the caller accepted pick-up and drop-off"
      pickup_address:
        description: "Address to collect the car from, as the caller gave it"
      pickup_time:
        description: "Date and time the caller wants the car collected, ISO 8601 with +04:00"
      customer_waits:
        description: "True when the caller wants to wait at the centre"
      booked_for_owner:
        description: "True when the caller is booking on someone else's profile"
      booked_by_name:
        description: "The caller's own name when they book for someone else"

        new_booking_reference: result.booking_reference
        booking_status: result.status

    description: "Send one templated message to the customer by SMS or WhatsApp. Templates: service_booking_confirmation (link to add to calendar, reschedule, cancel or track), service_booking_cancellation (confirms that the booking is cancelled), service_tracking_link (link to follow a car in the workshop), body_shop_tracking_link (link to the body shop tracking portal), test_drive_details (day, time, showroom map link, what to bring, confirmed or waiting for the showroom), location_and_hours, complaint_ticket, survey_invite. Can be sent again when the caller says it did not arrive. channel_used is sms or whatsapp."

    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      mobile_number:
        description: "Mobile number that receives the message, E.164"
      template:
        description: "Template name from the list in the description"
      channel:
        description: "sms or whatsapp. Leave empty to use the default configured in the notify service. The service does not fall back by itself: when a whatsapp send returns sent false, send once more with sms"
      reference:
        description: "Identifier the template is filled from: a booking reference, a test-drive reference, a complaint ticket number, a centre_id or a showroom_id"
      reference_type:
        description: "What the reference is: one of service_centre, showroom, booking, complaint. Needed for location_and_hours, which takes a service centre or a showroom"
      language:
        description: "en or ar, matching the language of the call"
    on_result:
      set:
        message_sent: result.sent

    effect: side_effect
    side_effects: true
    confirm: never
    params:
      team:
        description: "Receiving team, from the list in the description"
      request_type:

Price: price_callback, price_enquiry_not_booked, extra_work_price_callback. Car in the workshop: approval_needed, final_bill, status_missing, parts_update, repeat_problem, bill_higher_than_quoted. Recall and warranty: recall_enquiry, safety_recall, recall_cancelled, warranty_enquiry. Other service: imported_car, parts_enquiry, connected_app_help, roadside_recovery. Sales: sales_question, follow_up_chase, delivery_enquiry, plates_enquiry, invoice_enquiry, refund_enquiry, sales_complaint, summit_test_drive. Language: hindi_urdu_callback"
      summary:
        description: "What the customer needs and what was already done on the call, in two or three sentences"
      customer_mobile:
        description: "Number to call the customer back on, E.164"
      centre_id:
        description: "Service centre or showroom the request is for: a centre_id from find_service_centres or a showroom_id from find_showrooms. Required for service_centre, service_advisor and showroom_manager"
      customer_name:
        description: "Customer's name, when known"
      plate_number:
        description: "Plate of the car concerned"
      booking_reference:

When found is false, say that you do not have the number; never guess one."

CONSTRAINTS:
  always:
    # N24: nothing is booked before the caller has confirmed the read-back.
    - REQUIRE readback_confirmed == true BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: readback_prep
    # E85: the slot is held once picked, before it is booked.
    - REQUIRE slot_held == true BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: slot_lost
    # E52, N01: one booking per car, never booked twice.
    - REQUIRE booking_created != true BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stuck
    # C2, E59b, N03: cars that are not booked on this call.
    - REQUIRE booking_blocked != true BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stuck
    # E57: a GCC car bought outside Al-Futtaim gets the regular service only.
    - REQUIRE regular_service_only == true IMPLIES visit_type == "service" BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stuck
    # N02: the holiday list is checked before any slot is searched or offered.
    - REQUIRE holidays_checked == true BEFORE calling search_service_slots
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: holiday_check
    # Q08, E88: a message goes out only for a booking that exists.
    - REQUIRE booking_created == true OR existing_outcome == "resend_sms" BEFORE calling send_customer_message
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stuck
    # The visit type the booking system needs is settled before the booking is made.
    - REQUIRE booking_visit_type IS SET BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stuck
    # A team is emailed only from a step that has named the request.
    - REQUIRE request_type IS SET BEFORE calling send_team_request
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stuck
    # Nothing is held, booked or sent while a safety or person handover is pending.
    - REQUIRE safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true BEFORE calling hold_service_slot
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stop_or_stuck
    - REQUIRE safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true BEFORE calling create_service_booking
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stop_or_stuck
    - REQUIRE safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true BEFORE calling send_team_request
      ON_FAIL:
        GOTO: stop_or_stuck

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Phase 1: the car
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Every booking starts from a clean draft. E70: a second car in the same call is a new
  # entry: it comes back through the identity agent, which settles that car first.
  start:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [car_issue, regular_service_only, leased_allowed, owner_change_explained, owner_change_facts, booking_blocked, booked_for_owner, booked_by_name, existing_outcome, existing_restricted, visit_type, booking_visit_type, express_requested, job_capability, extra_jobs, caller_notes, job_note, said_place, said_when, mileage_status, booking_mileage, current_km, hint_given, service_agreed, service_code, service_label, service_plan, service_from_list, service_by_advisor, recall_ids_to_book, found_bookings, found_first, selected_centre_id, selected_centre_name, alternate_centre_id, search_centre_id, chosen_centre, other_centre, capable_list, centre_reject_count, last_centre_id, last_centre_name, last_centre_checked, preferred_advisor, pickup_address]
    SET:
      safety_flag = false
      booking_declined = false
      resume_choice = "pending"
      draft_stage = "open"
      rta_block_mentioned = false
      pickup_dropoff = false
      pudo_answered = false
      customer_waits = false
      location_requested = false
      another_car_pending = false
      walk_in_asked = false
      alternative_chosen = false
      price_asked = false
      weekend_request = false
    THEN: start_ready

  # The car arrives settled: the plate, and the vehicle id when the car is on file. It is not
  # looked up again and the caller is not asked for it. A request that arrives without a
  # plate has no car to book: a person takes over.
  start_ready:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [requested_date, window_start, window_end, fallback_date, search_until_date, same_day_request, same_day_too_soon, requested_day_free, holidays_checked, requested_holiday, holidays_found, slots_wanted, slots_that_day, slots_other_day, slots_other_centre, slot_outcome, selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start, selected_slot_label, slot_day, widen_count, slot_research_count, slot_held, slot_hold_id, readback_outcome, readback_confirmed, readback_bounces, create_attempts, create_errored, own_booking, booking_created, booking_reference, confirmation_sent, location_sent, request_team, request_type, request_needs_centre, request_summary, request_reply, request_outcome_line, warranty_line, auto_center_number, concern_note, record_note, pudo_unavailable, express_unavailable, price_known, price_missing, quoted_price_aed, price_note_centre, handover_reason, handover_summary]
    SET:
      contact_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(contact_mobile, caller_phone)
      call_language = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(call_language, "en")
    CHECK: plate_number IS SET AND plate_number != ""
    ON_FAIL: no_car
    THEN: car_record_gate

  no_car:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "car_not_settled"
    THEN: person_brief

  # What arrives (contract v2, section 2). For a car that is not on the profile in use the
  # identity agent returns the plate, the model and the facts, with an empty vehicle record id
  # and record status not_in_callers_name (K12a, E53, E12) or not_found. An empty value is not
  # known to replace an earlier one on its way back to the supervisor, so on a second car in
  # the same call (E70) the record id of the first car could still arrive here. The record
  # status decides: such a car is booked by plate and model, never by a record id, and every
  # step below that reads the record (service history, recalls, warranty, last centre) tests
  # the id and so stays away from it.
  car_record_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_record_status == "not_in_callers_name" OR vehicle_record_status == "not_found"
    ON_FAIL: guest_gate
    THEN: car_record_plate

  car_record_plate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      vehicle_id = ""
    THEN: car_missing_gate

  # A car that is not on the vehicle system has no model and no facts on record either: the
  # model is asked for once (model_ask), and no eligibility rule is applied from a record.
  car_missing_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_record_status == "not_found"
    ON_FAIL: guest_gate
    THEN: car_missing_blank

  car_missing_blank:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      vehicle_model = ""
      vehicle_spec_region = ""
      vehicle_ownership_type = ""
    THEN: guest_gate

  # The same for a guest (E12, E53): no profile is in use, whatever the calling number's own
  # profile is. The booking carries the caller's own name and no customer id.
  guest_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: identity_status == "guest"
    ON_FAIL: facts_outside_gate
    THEN: guest_blank

  guest_blank:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      crm_customer_id = ""
      customer_name = ""
    THEN: facts_outside_gate

  # Eligibility from the vehicle facts that arrive with the handoff. The routing table in
  # booking_router decides what happens (C2, E59b), together with what the caller says.
  # E57: a GCC car that Al-Futtaim did not sell gets the regular service only. The test is
  # "not known to be sold by Al-Futtaim", so the rule also holds if the value false did not
  # travel with the handoff.
  facts_outside_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_spec_region == "gcc" AND vehicle_sold_by_al_futtaim != true
    ON_FAIL: facts_block_gate
    THEN: facts_outside_set

  facts_outside_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      regular_service_only = true
    THEN: facts_block_gate

  # A car that cannot be booked on this call goes straight to the routing table; for any other
  # car: what is to be done?
  facts_block_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_record_status == "wrong" OR vehicle_record_status == "exported" OR vehicle_spec_region == "non_gcc" OR vehicle_ownership_type == "leased"
    ON_FAIL: need_talk
    THEN: booking_router

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Phase 3 (asked first, routed in phase 2): what the caller wants done
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # E69: a concern that is safe to drive goes in the notes. N16, N18, N19, Q10, C5: the kind
  # of visit. N03, C2, E59b, K12b, E70: what the caller says about the car sets car_issue.
  # Q12: a walk-in question is noted, and a booked time is looked for first.
  need_talk:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Understand what the caller wants done to the car{{#if vehicle_model}} ({{vehicle_model}}, plate {{plate_number}}){{/if}} from what they have already said. Ask only if it is not clear. Never ask which car or for the plate: the car is settled.
      If the caller says one of these about the car, set car_issue and ask nothing more:
      "limo" (a limousine or a limo company car), "imported" (US, Canadian, European or any other non-GCC specification), "leased" (a leased car), "owner_change" (they want the car moved into their name), "other_car" (they mean a different car from this one).
      Otherwise set visit_type to one of:
      "service": a regular scheduled service. If they want express service, also set express_requested to true and job_capability to "express"; express is only for a regular service.
      "recall": a recall visit. If they say the registration renewal is blocked because of a recall, also set rta_block_mentioned to true.
      "warranty": a warranty repair or check, not a service.
      "job_only": one job and no service, such as tyres, a battery or an AC check. Put the job in extra_jobs. For a smart repair, polish, detailing or tint also set job_capability to "smart_repair".
      "speed_limit_certificate": a speed limit certificate.
      "confirmation_resend": the caller says the confirmation message for a booking this car already has did not arrive. Ask nothing more.
      Record what they have already said without asking for it: the mileage (current_km, and mileage_status "given"), the place or centre they want (said_place), the day or time they want (said_when), jobs to add to a service (extra_jobs), a concern that is safe to drive (caller_notes). If no model is shown in the brackets above and the caller has said which Toyota model it is, set vehicle_model.
      If they ask whether they can just walk in: say you will look for a booked time first so the centre expects them, set walk_in_asked to true, and carry on with what the car needs.
      {{#if regular_service_only}}This car was bought outside Al-Futtaim, so only the regular service can be booked for it. If the caller wants anything else, say so plainly and offer the regular service.{{/if}}
      {{#if leased_allowed}}This is a leased car and it may be booked: do not set car_issue to "leased".{{/if}}
      {{#if owner_change_explained}}The owner change has already been explained: do not set car_issue to "owner_change" again; find out what the car needs.{{/if}}
      If the conversation shows that the owner change has already been explained to the caller on this call, do not set car_issue to "owner_change" for it: find out what the car needs.
      {{#if safety_note}}Earlier on this call the caller mentioned: {{safety_note}} (result of the safety check: {{safety_outcome}}). That has been dealt with and goes to the centre with the booking: do not ask about it again.{{/if}}
      An accident or body shop repair is not booked here: hand it back with __return_to_parent__.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: visit_type != "unknown" OR car_issue != "none" OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: router_gate

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Phase 2: existing booking, then the routing table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Every reasoning step that goes back to the routing table passes this gate first, so a
  # safety or person handover, or a caller who no longer wants to book, never waits for a lookup.
  router_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: other_car_gate

  # E70: the caller means another car. Nothing is booked for this one; the other car is
  # offered (next_car_unsettle, next_car_offer) and settled by the identity agent.
  other_car_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: car_issue == "other_car"
    ON_FAIL: booking_router
    THEN: next_car_unsettle

  # E52, E56, K11: the live booking check, from every channel, by plate. The booking system
  # matches every filter it is given, so the plate alone finds each booking of this car,
  # whichever phone made it. It runs before the centre is chosen and again directly before
  # the booking is made (after the read-back), so a booking made online a minute ago is seen.
  # The branch list below is the agent's routing table: first match wins.
  # A branch carries only booleans and paths. Every text value is set at step level, in the
  # small step the branch leads to: the compiler reads a quoted literal in a branch-level SET
  # as a variable name.
  booking_router:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_service_bookings
      WITH:
        plate_number: plate_number
      AS: existing_bookings
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: safety_flag == true
        THEN: safety_go
      - IF: needs_person == true
        THEN: person_go
      - IF: booking_declined == true
        THEN: after_car_gate
      - IF: existing_bookings.total IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - IF: car_issue == "record_problem" OR vehicle_record_status == "wrong" OR vehicle_record_status == "exported"
        THEN: block_record
      # N03: a limo is not booked; the branch is emailed and calls back.
      - IF: car_issue == "limo"
        THEN: block_limo
      # OPEN C2 (Aftersales workshop): What should the future process be? Can a service centre
      # accept a walk-in at its discretion? Interim: not booked, Auto Center emailed and its
      # toll-free number given. With the mode set to transfer the call goes to a person instead.
      - IF: (car_issue == "imported" OR vehicle_spec_region == "non_gcc") AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_NON_GCC_MODE}}" == "transfer")
        THEN: block_imported_person
      - IF: car_issue == "imported" OR vehicle_spec_region == "non_gcc"
        THEN: block_imported
      # OPEN E59b (Aftersales workshop): The contact centre suggests a person handles leased
      # cars. Agreed? Interim: a person. With the flag set to book, a leased car is booked.
      - IF: (car_issue == "leased" OR vehicle_ownership_type == "leased") AND leased_allowed != true AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_LEASED_CAR_MODE}}" == "book")
        THEN: leased_allow
      - IF: (car_issue == "leased" OR vehicle_ownership_type == "leased") AND leased_allowed != true
        THEN: block_leased
      # K12b: owner change, explained once, before anything else about a booking.
      - IF: car_issue == "owner_change" AND owner_change_explained != true
        SET:
          owner_change_explained = true
        THEN: owner_change_lookup
      # E52, E56, E88: a booking already exists for this car. The confirmation is not sent again
      # for a caller who books for the owner without the one-time code, nor for a caller whose
      # number is not the one on a booking found by plate alone: a person looks into it.
      - IF: existing_outcome == "resend_sms" AND identity_status == "third_party"
        THEN: resend_unverified
      - IF: existing_outcome == "resend_sms" AND existing_restricted == true
        THEN: resend_unverified
      - IF: existing_outcome == "resend_sms" AND contact_mobile IS SET AND contact_mobile != ""
        THEN: resend_check
      - IF: existing_outcome == "resend_sms"
        THEN: stop_or_stuck
      - IF: existing_outcome == "keep"
        THEN: after_car_gate
      # The booking that was read out is for this car; a caller who then says it is not the
      # car they mean wants another car: nothing more is booked for this one (E52, E70).
      - IF: existing_outcome == "not_this_car"
        THEN: next_car_unsettle
      - IF: existing_bookings.total > 0 AND existing_outcome == "pending"
        THEN: existing_gate
      # E88: the caller said the confirmation did not arrive and no booking is found for this
      # car: a person looks into it.
      - IF: visit_type == "confirmation_resend"
        THEN: resend_not_found
      # E86, K11, N24: the read-back outcome. Only a confirmed read-back with a contact name and
      # a number leads to the booking; a change goes back to that step and is read back again.
      # A yes without a name or a number goes back to the read-back once (readback_missing).
      - IF: readback_outcome == "confirmed" AND (booking_contact_name IS NOT SET OR booking_contact_name == "" OR contact_mobile IS NOT SET OR contact_mobile == "")
        THEN: readback_missing
      - IF: readback_outcome == "confirmed" AND (identity_status == "third_party" OR identity_status == "third_party_verified")
        SET:
          readback_confirmed = true
        THEN: commit_for_owner
      - IF: readback_outcome == "confirmed"
        SET:
          readback_confirmed = true
        THEN: commit_create
      - IF: readback_outcome == "change_time"
        THEN: when_start
      - IF: readback_outcome == "change_centre"
        CLEAR: [readback_outcome, selected_centre_id, selected_centre_name, alternate_centre_id]
        THEN: centre_talk
      - IF: readback_outcome == "change_service"
        CLEAR: [readback_outcome, visit_type, booking_visit_type, service_agreed, hint_given, service_plan, service_code, service_label, service_from_list, service_by_advisor, alternative_chosen, price_asked, price_known, price_missing, recall_ids_to_book, job_note, job_capability, express_requested]
        THEN: need_talk
      # OPEN N24 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call?
      - IF: resume_choice == "continue" AND service_agreed != true
        THEN: resume_restore
      - IF: ("{{env.TOYOTA_BOOKING_RESUME_ENABLED}}" != "false") AND resume_choice == "pending" AND service_agreed != true AND user.toyota_booking_draft.draft_stage == "open" AND user.toyota_booking_draft.plate_number == plate_number
        THEN: resume_offer
      # What the car needs.
      - IF: visit_type == "unknown" AND car_issue == "none"
        THEN: need_talk
      # E57: anything but the regular service for a car bought outside Al-Futtaim: a person.
      - IF: regular_service_only == true AND visit_type != "service"
        THEN: block_outside_work
      # E74: a car that is not on file has no model on record; it is asked for before a visit
      # is booked, because the services and the centres that take the car depend on it.
      - IF: visit_type == "service" AND (vehicle_model IS NOT SET OR vehicle_model == "")
        THEN: model_ask
      - IF: visit_type == "service" AND mileage_status == "pending"
        THEN: mileage_ask
      - IF: visit_type == "service"
        THEN: service_gate
      # OPEN N18 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call?
      - IF: visit_type == "recall" AND rta_block_mentioned == true AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_RTA_RECALL_BLOCK_ENABLED}}" == "false")
        THEN: block_rta
      # Q10: a recall is checked on the car record. Without a record it is an enquiry, and so
      # it is for a caller who books for the owner without the one-time code (no record details).
      - IF: visit_type == "recall" AND vehicle_id IS SET AND vehicle_id != "" AND identity_status != "third_party"
        THEN: recall_lookup
      - IF: visit_type == "recall"
        THEN: recall_enquiry
      # Q10: a warranty visit is an enquiry to the service centre, with the dates when known
      # (no dates for a caller who books for the owner without the one-time code).
      - IF: visit_type == "warranty" AND vehicle_id IS SET AND vehicle_id != "" AND identity_status != "third_party"
        THEN: warranty_start
      - IF: visit_type == "warranty"
        THEN: warranty_enquiry
      # OPEN N16 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call?
      # Interim: a visit is booked with the job added, as the contact centre does today.
      - IF: visit_type == "job_only" AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_JOB_ONLY_VISIT_ENABLED}}" == "false")
        THEN: block_job_only
      - IF: visit_type == "job_only" AND (vehicle_model IS NOT SET OR vehicle_model == "")
        THEN: model_ask
      - IF: visit_type == "job_only"
        THEN: job_only_start
      # OPEN N19 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call?
      # Interim: the centre is checked for the certificate (centre_verify), booked with a note.
      - IF: visit_type == "speed_limit_certificate" AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_SPEED_LIMIT_CERTIFICATE_ENABLED}}" == "false")
        THEN: block_certificate
      - IF: visit_type == "speed_limit_certificate" AND (vehicle_model IS NOT SET OR vehicle_model == "")
        THEN: model_ask
      - IF: visit_type == "speed_limit_certificate"
        THEN: certificate_start
      - ELSE:
        THEN: stop_or_stuck
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # The small steps of the routing table: each sets the reason or the request at step level.
  block_record:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_blocked = true
      handover_reason = "car_record_wrong_or_exported"
    THEN: person_brief

  # N03: the limo request goes to the branch.
  block_limo:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_blocked = true
      request_team = "service_centre"
      request_type = "limo_booking"
      request_needs_centre = true
    THEN: request_brief

  # C2 (open): with the mode set to transfer, a person takes the imported car.
  block_imported_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_blocked = true
      handover_reason = "imported_car"
    THEN: person_brief

  # C2 (open): the details go to the Auto Center, the team for imported cars.
  block_imported:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_blocked = true
      request_team = "auto_center_imports"
      request_type = "imported_car"
      request_needs_centre = false
    THEN: request_brief

  # E59b (open): with the flag set to book, a leased car is booked like any other car.
  leased_allow:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      car_issue = "none"
      leased_allowed = true
    THEN: need_talk

  # E59b (open): a leased car goes to a person until agreed.
  block_leased:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_blocked = true
      handover_reason = "leased_car"
    THEN: person_brief

  resend_unverified:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "confirmation_resend_caller_not_verified"
    THEN: person_brief

  resend_not_found:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_not_found"
    THEN: person_brief

  # E57: other work on a car bought outside Al-Futtaim is not booked here.
  block_outside_work:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "outside_car_other_work"
    THEN: person_brief

  # N18 (open): with the flag set to false, a registration block goes to a person.
  block_rta:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "rta_recall_block"
    THEN: person_brief

  # Q10: a recall that cannot be checked on the record is an enquiry to the service centre.
  recall_enquiry:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_team = "service_centre"
      request_type = "recall_enquiry"
      request_needs_centre = true
    THEN: request_brief

  # Q10: a warranty visit, with the dates from the car record first.
  warranty_start:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_team = "service_centre"
      request_type = "warranty_enquiry"
      request_needs_centre = true
    THEN: warranty_lookup

  warranty_enquiry:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_team = "service_centre"
      request_type = "warranty_enquiry"
      request_needs_centre = true
    THEN: request_brief

  # N16 (open): with the flag set to false, a visit for one job goes to a person.
  block_job_only:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "job_only_visit"
    THEN: person_brief

  # N16 (open): a visit with the job added and no service: no service code, and no express.
  job_only_start:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [service_code]
    SET:
      booking_visit_type = "job_only"
      service_label = "a visit for the requested job"
      express_requested = false
      service_agreed = true
      resume_choice = "started"
    THEN: centre_known_gate

  # N19 (open): with the flag set to false, a speed limit certificate goes to a person.
  block_certificate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "speed_limit_certificate"
    THEN: person_brief

  # N19 (open): booked as a visit for one job, with a note; the centre must offer it.
  certificate_start:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [service_code]
    SET:
      booking_visit_type = "job_only"
      service_label = "a speed limit certificate"
      job_capability = "speed_limit_certificate"
      job_note = "Speed limit certificate requested."
      express_requested = false
      service_agreed = true
      resume_choice = "started"
    THEN: centre_known_gate

  # E52, E56: a booking exists for this car. A caller who books for the owner without the
  # one-time code is told only that there is one: the booking is not shown to the model.
  existing_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: identity_status == "third_party"
    ON_FAIL: existing_view
    THEN: existing_tell

  # Only what the caller may hear is passed on: the names, numbers and notes on a booking
  # stay out of the model's view.
  existing_view:
    REASONING: false
    TRANSFORM: existing_bookings.bookings AS found INTO found_bookings
      MAP:
        booking_reference: found.booking_reference
        centre_name: found.centre_name
        start_label: found.start_label
        service_label: found.service_label
        status: found.status
        can_change: found.can_change
    THEN: existing_first

  # E88: the booking found first, for a resend, and the last three digits of the number.
  existing_first:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      found_first = existing_bookings.bookings[0]
      contact_last_digits = SUBSTRING(contact_mobile, SUB(LENGTH(contact_mobile), 3))
    THEN: existing_plate_gate

  # E56: "by plate and phone". A car on the profile in use is the caller's own car, and its
  # booking is read out (E52). A car that is booked by plate only (a guest, a car not in the
  # caller's name, a car that is not on the vehicle system) proves nothing about the caller:
  # anyone can say a plate. Its booking is read out, and its confirmation sent again, only
  # when the caller's number is the one on the booking, or the booking belongs to the profile
  # in use. Otherwise the caller hears only that the car already has a booking, as a caller
  # who books for the owner without the one-time code does, and a change is handed back.
  existing_plate_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_id IS SET AND vehicle_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: existing_phone_gate
    THEN: existing_tell

  existing_phone_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: found_first.contact_mobile IS SET AND found_first.contact_mobile != "" AND (found_first.contact_mobile == contact_mobile OR found_first.contact_mobile == caller_phone)
    ON_FAIL: existing_owner_gate
    THEN: existing_tell

  existing_owner_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: crm_customer_id IS SET AND crm_customer_id != "" AND found_first.belongs_to_customer_id == crm_customer_id
    ON_FAIL: existing_hide
    THEN: existing_tell

  existing_hide:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [found_bookings]
    SET:
      existing_restricted = true
    THEN: existing_tell

  # E52: read it out and offer to change it; one booking per car. E56: every booking returned
  # is for this plate. E88: the read-out is the backup and the message can be sent again.
  # The booking system also returns a booking whose time has passed today, and a car that is
  # in the workshop today: each is told as what it is, and none is doubled by a new booking.
  existing_tell:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The booking system already shows a booking for this car, plate {{plate_number}}. There is one booking per car, so never offer or make a second one.
      {{#if found_bookings}}The booking: {{found_bookings | json}}. Say the day and time as start_label gives them. If its status is "confirmed", read it out (the centre, then the day and time) and offer to change it. If its status is "missed", say the booked time has passed and offer to move it to a new time. If its status is "in_workshop", say the car is booked in at the centre today.{{/if}}
      Then:
      - They want to change, move or cancel it, or ask how the car in the workshop is doing: hand the request back with __return_to_parent__.
      - They keep it as it is: set existing_outcome to "keep" and say nothing more.
      - They say the confirmation message did not arrive: what you read out is their backup. Say the message goes to the number ending {{contact_last_digits}} and ask if that is right.
