If no digits are shown, or they want another number, take the number, read it back in full in groups, and set contact_mobile once they say yes. Then set booking_reference to that booking's reference and existing_outcome to "resend_sms".
      - They mean a different car: set car_issue to "other_car" and existing_outcome to "not_this_car".
      {{#if (eq visit_type "confirmation_resend")}}The caller has already said that the confirmation message did not arrive: go straight to that.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq identity_status "third_party")}}The caller is booking for the owner and has not been verified: say only that this car already has a booking. Do not give its details and do not send its confirmation again; hand a change back with __return_to_parent__.{{/if}}
      {{#if existing_restricted}}This booking was made with another phone number and is not on a profile of this caller: say only that this car already has a booking. Do not give its details and do not send its confirmation again; hand a change back with __return_to_parent__.{{/if}}
      Set call_language to "en" or "ar", the language the caller is speaking.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: existing_outcome != "pending" OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: router_gate

  # E88: the confirmation is sent again only for a booking that was just read out. When the
  # reference the model wrote is not one of them, the booking found first is used.
  resend_check:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      resend_booking = ARRAY_FIND(found_bookings, "booking_reference", booking_reference)
    THEN: resend_reference

  resend_reference:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_reference = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(resend_booking.booking_reference, found_first.booking_reference)
    THEN: resend_ready

  resend_ready:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_reference IS SET AND booking_reference != ""
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: confirm_channel_gate

  # OPEN N24 (contact centre): How often does the contact centre get this call?
  # Nothing was booked before the read-back, so the caller is offered to finish where it stopped.
  # When the answer to the offer is not clear, the booking simply starts from the beginning.
  resume_offer:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      A booking for this car was started earlier, on an earlier call or earlier on this one, and stopped before it was confirmed, so nothing was booked.
      It had got as far as: {{user.toyota_booking_draft.service_label}}{{#if user.toyota_booking_draft.selected_centre_name}} at {{user.toyota_booking_draft.selected_centre_name}}{{/if}}.
      Tell the caller that nothing was booked and offer to carry on from there.
      Set resume_choice to "continue" if they want that, or to "restart" if they want to start again or want something different.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: resume_choice != "pending" OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: resume_skip
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: router_gate

  resume_skip:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      resume_choice = "restart"
    THEN: router_gate

  resume_restore:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      visit_type = user.toyota_booking_draft.visit_type
      booking_visit_type = user.toyota_booking_draft.booking_visit_type
      service_code = user.toyota_booking_draft.service_code
      service_label = user.toyota_booking_draft.service_label
      job_capability = user.toyota_booking_draft.job_capability
      express_requested = user.toyota_booking_draft.express_requested
      extra_jobs = user.toyota_booking_draft.extra_jobs
      current_km = user.toyota_booking_draft.current_km
      mileage_status = user.toyota_booking_draft.mileage_status
      booking_mileage = user.toyota_booking_draft.booking_mileage
      job_note = user.toyota_booking_draft.job_note
      caller_notes = user.toyota_booking_draft.caller_notes
      recall_ids_to_book = user.toyota_booking_draft.recall_ids_to_book
      selected_centre_id = user.toyota_booking_draft.selected_centre_id
      selected_centre_name = user.toyota_booking_draft.selected_centre_name
      service_agreed = true
      resume_choice = "restored"
    THEN: centre_known_gate

  # OPEN K12b (Aftersales workshop): Should we plan an AI-supported or self-service owner change
  # after launch? Interim: explain that it is done at the centre, then book a service if wanted.
  # What to bring and the fee come from the approved content, read here once.
  owner_change_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_toyota_knowledge
      WITH:
        query: "owner change at the service centre: documents to bring and fee"
      AS: owner_change_info
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: owner_change_info.results IS SET
        SET:
          owner_change_facts = owner_change_info.results
        THEN: owner_change_talk
      - ELSE:
        THEN: owner_change_talk
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: owner_change_talk

  owner_change_talk:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller wants the car moved into their name.
      {{#if owner_change_facts}}What the approved content says about an owner change: {{owner_change_facts | json}}.{{/if}}
      Explain that the change of owner is done at the service centre and what to bring, from what is shown above. If nothing is shown, say it is done at the centre with the Mulkiya, their ID and a fee.
      Never state a fee amount that is not shown above, and give no registration or legal advice.
      Then ask whether they would also like to book a service.
      If yes, set car_issue to "none", and set visit_type as well if they said what the car needs. If no, set booking_declined to true and say nothing more.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: car_issue != "owner_change" OR booking_declined == true OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: router_gate

  # E74: a car that is not on file has no model on record. It is asked for once, in one
  # question; without it the visit cannot be matched to a service or a centre: a person.
  model_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The model of this car is not on record. Unless the caller has already said it, ask in one short question which Toyota model it is.
      Set vehicle_model to the model name, for example Corolla or Land Cruiser.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: (vehicle_model IS SET AND vehicle_model != "") OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 2
    ON_EXHAUSTED: model_missing
    THEN: model_flags

  model_flags:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: model_gate

  model_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_model IS SET AND vehicle_model != ""
    ON_FAIL: model_missing
    THEN: booking_router

  model_missing:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "car_model_not_captured"
    THEN: person_brief

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Phase 3: what the car needs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # E66: the mileage is asked once. Two attempts bound the step: the question, then the answer.
  mileage_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Ask once, in one short question, for the car's current mileage in kilometres.
      When the caller answers, always record the outcome and never ask a second time:
      - a figure: set current_km and mileage_status to "given";
      - they are not sure or only guess: set mileage_status to "unsure";
      - they do not know it: set mileage_status to "unknown".
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: mileage_status != "pending" OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 2
    ON_EXHAUSTED: mileage_after
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: mileage_after

  # E66: asked once. When the step ends without an answer, the mileage counts as not known,
  # so the question is never put a second time on a later pass through the routing table.
  mileage_after:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: mileage_status == "pending"
    ON_FAIL: service_gate
    THEN: mileage_unknown_set

  mileage_unknown_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      mileage_status = "unknown"
    THEN: service_gate

  service_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_visit_type = "service"
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: express_gate

  # C5: express service is for a regular service, only at a centre that offers it. Asking for
  # it makes express the capability the centre must have, whichever of the two the model set.
  express_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: express_requested == true OR job_capability == "express"
    ON_FAIL: service_source
    THEN: express_set

  express_set:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      express_requested = true
      job_capability = "express"
    THEN: service_source

  # A car on file that Al-Futtaim sold has a service history to work from. E57: a car bought
  # outside Al-Futtaim, and a car that is not on file, take the service from the list of
  # scheduled services for the model.
  service_source:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_id IS SET AND vehicle_id != "" AND regular_service_only != true
    ON_FAIL: service_guest
    THEN: service_lookup

  # P03, K05: the next service comes from the service history, with the caller's mileage.
  service_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_service_recommendation
      WITH:
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
        current_km: current_km
      AS: service_rec
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: service_rec.next_service_code IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      # No history to work from: booked as a regular service, like a car that is not on file.
      - IF: service_rec.next_service_code == ""
        THEN: service_guest
      # P03: not sure of the mileage: the last visit's mileage is given once. It is a detail
      # from the owner's record, so it is not given to a caller who books for the owner
      # without having passed the one-time code.
      - IF: mileage_status == "unsure" AND hint_given != true AND service_rec.last_visit_km > 0 AND identity_status != "third_party"
        SET:
          hint_given = true
          service_plan = service_rec
        THEN: mileage_hint
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          service_plan = service_rec
          service_code = service_rec.next_service_code
          service_label = service_rec.next_service_label
        THEN: mileage_note_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # E57: a real service code for a car that has no history here, from the scheduled services
  # for the model and the caller's mileage. For a car bought outside Al-Futtaim it is always a
  # regular service by mileage. When the mileage picks none, the first regular service of the
  # model is booked and the service advisor confirms the exact service.
  service_guest:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: list_service_types
      WITH:
        vehicle_model: vehicle_model
        current_km: current_km
      AS: service_types
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: service_types.total > 0
        SET:
          service_types_found = service_types.services
          service_types_code = service_types.recommended_service_code
        THEN: service_guest_pick
      - ELSE:
        THEN: service_guest_none
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  service_guest_pick:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      type_by_km = ARRAY_FIND(service_types_found, "service_code", service_types_code)
      type_regular = ARRAY_FIND(service_types_found, "is_regular_periodic", true)
    THEN: service_guest_km_gate

  service_guest_km_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: type_by_km.service_code IS SET AND type_by_km.service_code != "" AND (regular_service_only != true OR type_by_km.is_regular_periodic == true)
    ON_FAIL: service_guest_regular_gate
    THEN: service_guest_by_km

  service_guest_by_km:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      service_code = type_by_km.service_code
      service_label = type_by_km.label
      service_from_list = true
      service_by_advisor = false
    THEN: mileage_note_gate

  service_guest_regular_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: type_regular.service_code IS SET AND type_regular.service_code != ""
    ON_FAIL: service_guest_none
    THEN: service_guest_regular

  service_guest_regular:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      service_code = type_regular.service_code
      service_label = "a regular service"
      service_from_list = false
      service_by_advisor = true
    THEN: mileage_note_gate

  # No scheduled service is listed for this model: a person takes over.
  service_guest_none:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "no_service_listed_for_model"
    THEN: person_brief

  # P03: the last visit's mileage as a hint; still unsure leads to the Unsure KM note.
  mileage_hint:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      The caller is not sure of the mileage. Tell them the mileage at their last visit, {{service_plan.last_visit_km}} km, and ask once roughly what it is now. Mention nothing else from the service history.
      A figure: set current_km and mileage_status to "given". Still not sure: set mileage_status to "unsure_final".
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: mileage_status != "unsure" OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 2
    ON_EXHAUSTED: service_gate
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: service_gate

  # E66: No Mileage note. P03: Unsure KM note for the service advisor. The booking system
  # writes the standard note itself from the mileage status that goes with the booking:
  # known, unsure or unknown.
  mileage_note_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_mileage = "known"
    CHECK: mileage_status == "given"
    ON_FAIL: mileage_note_pick
    THEN: visit_confirm

  mileage_note_pick:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_mileage = "unknown"
    CHECK: mileage_status == "unsure" OR mileage_status == "unsure_final"
    ON_FAIL: visit_confirm
    THEN: mileage_note_unsure

  mileage_note_unsure:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_mileage = "unsure"
    THEN: visit_confirm

  # P03: proposes the next service. E65: past the due mileage. E67: not due yet. E63: prepaid.
  # Price only if asked: the model raises price_asked and the price is looked up in price_lookup.
  # Also confirms a bookable recall visit (Q10).
  visit_confirm:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Agree with the caller what will be booked{{#if vehicle_model}} for the {{vehicle_model}}{{/if}}, in one or two short sentences. If they have already asked for exactly this, record the agreement without asking again.
      {{#if (eq visit_type "recall")}}The car record shows an open recall that can be booked: {{job_note}}. Tell the caller and offer to book the visit for it.{{/if}}
      {{#if service_by_advisor}}There is no service history to work from for this car: offer a regular service and say the service advisor confirms the exact service from the mileage.{{/if}}
      {{#if service_from_list}}From the mileage, the service for this car is the {{service_label}}.{{/if}}
      {{#if service_plan.next_service_label}}From the service history the next service is the {{service_plan.next_service_label}}. Due now: {{service_plan.is_due}}. Interval: {{service_plan.interval_km}} km. Next due date: {{service_plan.next_due_date}}. If it is not due now, give the interval and the next due date and ask whether they still want to book it now.{{/if}}
      {{#if service_plan.alternative_service_label}}The car is past the due mileage, so ask which one they want, the {{service_plan.next_service_label}} or the {{service_plan.alternative_service_label}}, in the style of "the 50,000 or the 60,000?". Set alternative_chosen to true if they choose the second, and to false if they choose the first.{{/if}}
      {{#if service_plan.covered_by_prepaid_contract}}This service is covered by their prepaid service contract, so tell them, in the style of "Your 40,000 km service is already paid".{{/if}}
      {{#if regular_service_only}}This car was bought outside Al-Futtaim: only this regular service can be booked for it, with no other jobs.{{/if}}
      Never give a price unless the caller asks. If they ask the price of this service, set price_asked to true and say nothing else in that turn: the price is looked up for you. Never price extra work.
      {{#if price_known}}They asked the price: this scheduled service costs {{quoted_price_aed}} dirhams. Say the amount in words and that the service advisor confirms the final bill, then ask whether they want to go ahead. Do not set price_asked again unless they ask about a different service.{{/if}}
      {{#if price_missing}}They asked the price and you do not have it for this visit: say the service advisor will confirm the price, then ask whether they want to go ahead. Do not set price_asked again.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq identity_status "third_party")}}The caller is booking for the owner and has not been verified: name the service to be booked, but do not mention the service contract, the last visit or other details from the owner's record.{{/if}}
      When they agree, set service_agreed to true. If they decide not to book, set booking_declined to true and say nothing: the next step tells them that nothing has been booked.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: service_agreed == true OR price_asked == true OR booking_declined == true OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: service_choice_gate

  # E65: the service the caller chose is set here from the service history, so the code that
  # is booked and the name that is read back always belong together.
  service_choice_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: alternative_chosen == true AND service_plan.alternative_service_code IS SET AND service_plan.alternative_service_code != ""
    ON_FAIL: service_choice_next_gate
    THEN: service_choice_alt

  service_choice_alt:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      service_code = service_plan.alternative_service_code
      service_label = service_plan.alternative_service_label
    THEN: price_gate

  service_choice_next_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: visit_type == "service" AND service_plan.next_service_code IS SET AND service_plan.next_service_code != ""
    ON_FAIL: price_gate
    THEN: service_choice_next

  service_choice_next:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      service_code = service_plan.next_service_code
      service_label = service_plan.next_service_label
    THEN: price_gate

  # P03: price only if asked, only for the scheduled service, and only from the price list.
  price_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: price_asked == true AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: service_route
    THEN: price_code_gate

  price_code_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      price_asked = false
      price_known = false
      price_missing = true
    CHECK: visit_type == "service" AND service_code IS SET AND service_code != ""
    ON_FAIL: visit_confirm
    THEN: price_lookup

  # The price is asked for with the car when it is on file, otherwise with the model. A price
  # of 0 means none can be given: the service advisor confirms it.
  price_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_service_price
      WITH:
        service_code: service_code
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
        vehicle_model: vehicle_model
        include_price: true
      AS: service_price
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: service_price.price_aed > 0
        SET:
          quoted_price_aed = service_price.price_aed
          price_known = true
          price_missing = false
        THEN: visit_confirm
      - ELSE:
        THEN: visit_confirm
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: visit_confirm

  # N24: from here on the draft that is kept for a dropped call belongs to this call, so it is
  # never offered back to the caller as an earlier call (resume_choice leaves pending).
  service_route:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      resume_choice = "started"
    CHECK: service_agreed == true AND booking_declined != true AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: centre_known_gate

  # OPEN Q10 (Aftersales workshop): Should the AI agent book every running recall, or does the
  # brand confirm each car first? What wording should the warranty date disclaimer use?
  # Interim: the record is checked; an open safety recall goes to the centre now; an open
  # running recall that can be booked is booked; anything else is an enquiry to the centre.
  recall_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_open_recalls
      WITH:
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
      AS: recall_record
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: recall_record.total IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - ELSE:
        THEN: recall_sort
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # Q10: recalls that are not done yet.
  recall_sort:
    REASONING: false
    TRANSFORM: recall_record.recalls AS recall_item INTO open_recalls
      FILTER: recall_item.completed == false
    THEN: recall_pick

  # Q10: an open safety recall is not booked into a slot: it goes to the service centre now.
  recall_pick:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      open_safety_recall = ARRAY_FIND(open_recalls, "category", "safety")
      open_bookable_recall = ARRAY_FIND(open_recalls, "bookable", true)
      open_any_recall = ARRAY_FIND(open_recalls, "completed", false)
      recall_count = LENGTH(recall_record.recalls)
      request_team = "service_centre"
      request_type = "safety_recall"
      request_needs_centre = true
    THEN: recall_safety_gate

  recall_safety_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: open_safety_recall.recall_id IS SET
    ON_FAIL: recall_route_running
    THEN: request_brief

  # Q10, N18: an open running recall that can be booked is booked like any visit.
  recall_route_running:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_type = "recall_enquiry"
      job_note = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(open_bookable_recall.title, "")
    CHECK: open_bookable_recall.recall_id IS SET AND ("{{env.TOYOTA_RECALL_BOOK_RUNNING}}" != "false")
    ON_FAIL: recall_route_done
    THEN: recall_book_set

  # A recall visit carries the recall and no service code, and it is never an express visit.
  recall_book_set:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [service_code]
    SET:
      booking_visit_type = "recall"
      service_label = "recall work"
      recall_ids_to_book = SPLIT(open_bookable_recall.recall_id, ",")
      express_requested = false
    THEN: visit_confirm

  # N18: every recall on the record is done: the caller is asked to visit the centre so it can
  # be updated. Otherwise (open but not bookable, or none on record): an enquiry to the centre.
  recall_route_done:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: open_any_recall.recall_id IS NOT SET AND recall_count > 0
    ON_FAIL: request_brief
    THEN: recall_done

  recall_done:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "Our records show the recall work on this car is already done. If your registration renewal is still blocked, please visit the service centre so they can update it."
    MESSAGE_KEY: recall_already_done
    THEN: after_car_gate

  # Q10: warranty dates from the car record, with the note that the centre confirms the cover.
  warranty_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_warranty_status
      WITH:
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
      AS: warranty_record
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: warranty_record.in_warranty IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - ELSE:
        THEN: warranty_tell
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # Order of speech (contract v2, section 2): the request step that follows can finish in the
  # same turn, when the centre and the number are already known, and the fixed lines after it
  # would then be heard before a sentence spoken here. So this step words the dates in the
  # caller's language, writes them to warranty_line and says nothing; warranty_say, a fixed
  # step, says them, and the request step speaks after it. The step always ends after one pass
  # and never waits for the caller: when nothing was written, warranty_fallback says in one
  # fixed line that the centre confirms the dates and the cover.
  warranty_tell:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Word what the caller is to hear about the warranty and write it to warranty_line: at most two short sentences, in the language the caller is speaking (English or Gulf Arabic), worded exactly as they are to be said on the phone, with every date in words (for example 12 March 2027).
      Do not say anything yourself in this step: the next step says what you write, and anything you say here would be heard twice. After writing warranty_line, end your turn with no text at all.
      Warranty end date on the car record: {{warranty_record.warranty_end_date}}{{#if warranty_record.extended_warranty_end_date}}; extended warranty end date: {{warranty_record.extended_warranty_end_date}}{{/if}}. If no date is shown, say the service centre will confirm the warranty dates.
      Add that the service centre confirms what is covered. Never say that a repair is or is not covered.
      Call no tool except to save warranty_line, and put no question at the end: the next step asks what is still needed and passes the request to the service centre.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: always
    THEN: warranty_said_gate

  warranty_said_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: warranty_line IS SET AND warranty_line != ""
    ON_FAIL: warranty_fallback
    THEN: warranty_say

  warranty_say:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "{{warranty_line}}"
    MESSAGE_KEY: warranty_line
    THEN: request_brief

  warranty_fallback:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "The service centre will confirm your warranty dates and what is covered."
    MESSAGE_KEY: warranty_centre_confirms
    THEN: request_brief

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Phase 4: the service centre
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # A centre that is already agreed is not asked for again: after the caller changed what is
  # booked at the read-back (E86), and when an unfinished booking is carried on (N24). It goes
  # straight to the check that the centre can take this visit (centre_verify); a centre that
  # fails the check is agreed again (centre_reject). Without a centre, the centre is agreed.
  centre_known_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: selected_centre_id IS SET AND selected_centre_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: centre_start
    THEN: centre_picked_gate

  # E71: the last centre from the service history, read once before the centre is discussed.
  # It is a detail of the owner's record: it is not read for a caller who books for the owner
  # without the one-time code, and there is none for a car that is not on file.
  centre_start:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_id IS SET AND vehicle_id != "" AND identity_status != "third_party" AND last_centre_checked != true
    ON_FAIL: centre_talk
    THEN: last_centre_lookup

  # The booking carries on without it when the last visit cannot be read.
  last_centre_lookup:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      last_centre_checked = true
    CALL: get_last_service_visit
      WITH:
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
      AS: last_visit
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: last_visit.found == true
        SET:
          last_centre_id = last_visit.centre_id
          last_centre_name = last_visit.centre_name
        THEN: centre_talk
      - ELSE:
        THEN: centre_talk
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: centre_talk

  # E71: the last centre from the service history. E72: a place is worked out to an area; the
  # emirate is asked only if unclear. E73, K05, C5: only centres that take the car and the job.
  # OPEN E74 (contact centre): Which centres do hybrid, electric, GR and commercial work? Which
  # Toyota centres take Coasters? Interim: only centres the search returns for the car and job.
  # OPEN K07 (contact centre): Is this still right? Key drop is answered from the centre data.
  # OPEN K08 (contact centre): Is this still right? Shuttle is answered from the centre data.
  centre_talk:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Agree the service centre for this visit: {{service_label}}{{#if vehicle_model}} for the {{vehicle_model}}{{/if}}.
      {{#if said_place}}The caller has already mentioned: {{said_place}}.{{/if}}
      {{#if centre_reject_count}}The centre chosen before cannot do this job or take this car. Choose again, from the search results only.{{/if}}
      Always search with find_service_centres, passing capability "{{job_capability}}" and the vehicle model when it is known, and offer only centres it returns, nearest first, two at most at a time.
      {{#if last_centre_name}}- Same centre as last time: the last visit of this car was at {{last_centre_name}} (centre id {{last_centre_id}}). Offer it when the caller asks for the same centre as last time, if it is in the search results. If it is not, say it cannot take this visit and offer the nearest that can.{{/if}}
      - If they ask for the same centre as last time and no last centre is shown here, ask which centre or area they mean.
      - A centre by its name: search with centre_name.
      - A place or a landmark instead of a centre: search with area_or_landmark, in the caller's own words. Ask for the emirate only if the search returns emirate_needed true, then search again with the emirate and offer the centres there.
      - A centre that is not in the results, for example for a Supra or an 86, for express service or for a speed limit certificate: say that centre cannot do it and offer the ones that can.
      Per current policy a Supra or an 86, and express service, are taken only at Al Badia, SZR or Wave. The search is the source of truth: if it returns a different list, follow the search.
      Key drop and shuttle: answer only from what the search returns for that centre (key_drop, shuttle). If the caller will drop the key after hours, add that to caller_notes.
      When the caller chooses, set selected_centre_id and selected_centre_name, and set alternate_centre_id to the next nearest centre in the results if there is one.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [find_service_centres, search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: selected_centre_id IS SET OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_TURNS: 5
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 5
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: centre_picked_gate

  centre_picked_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: selected_centre_id IS SET AND selected_centre_id != "" AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: centre_verify

  # E74, K05, E73, C5, N19: the booking is only made at a centre that can do the job and take
  # the car. The chosen centre must be in the list for this capability and model.
  centre_verify:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_service_centres
      WITH:
        capability: job_capability
        vehicle_model: vehicle_model
      AS: capable_centres
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: capable_centres.total IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          capable_list = capable_centres.centres
        THEN: centre_match
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  centre_match:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      chosen_centre = ARRAY_FIND(capable_list, "centre_id", selected_centre_id)
      other_centre = ARRAY_FIND(capable_list, "centre_id", alternate_centre_id)
    THEN: centre_gate

  centre_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      selected_centre_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(chosen_centre.name, selected_centre_name)
    CHECK: chosen_centre.centre_id IS SET
    ON_FAIL: centre_reject
    THEN: pudo_gate

  centre_reject:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [selected_centre_id, selected_centre_name, alternate_centre_id]
    SET:
      centre_reject_count = ADD(centre_reject_count, 1)
    THEN: centre_reject_gate

  centre_reject_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: centre_reject_count < 2
    ON_FAIL: centre_person
    THEN: centre_talk

  centre_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "no_capable_centre"
    THEN: person_brief

  # OPEN E75 (contact centre): When a customer accepts pick-up and drop-off, does the contact
  # centre agent book the chauffeur or AFL job during the call? Interim: offered on every
  # booking call where the centre has it, and added to the booking if accepted; the centre
  # arranges the collection after the call. Whether a centre has pick-up and drop-off, and
  # any current free collection offer, come from the centre data.
  # Cancelling a chauffeur pick-up on a booking that exists (K03, E101: the late-cancel fee)
  # is a change to that booking: it is handed back, and the booking system returns the fee.
  pudo_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_PUDO_OFFER_EVERY_BOOKING}}" != "false") AND pudo_answered != true AND chosen_centre.pickup_dropoff == true
    ON_FAIL: when_start
    THEN: pudo_offer

  pudo_offer:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Offer pick-up and drop-off once: we can collect the car and bring it back.
      {{#if chosen_centre.free_collection_offer}}Current free collection offer at this centre: {{chosen_centre.free_collection_offer}}. Mention it.{{/if}}
      Never state a fee or an offer that is not shown here.
      Accepted: set pickup_dropoff to true, set pickup_address if they give a collection address, add a time wish for the collection to caller_notes if they give one, and say it is added to the booking and the centre confirms the collection details.
      Declined: set pickup_dropoff to false. In both cases set pudo_answered to true and do not offer it again.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: pudo_answered == true OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_TURNS: 3
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3
    ON_EXHAUSTED: pudo_skip
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: when_start

  # Offered once: an offer that got no clear answer is not made again.
  pudo_skip:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      pudo_answered = true
    THEN: when_start

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Phase 5: the day and time
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # E86: also the way back from the read-back when the caller changes the day or time.
  when_start:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [requested_date, window_start, window_end, fallback_date, search_until_date, slots_wanted, slots_that_day, slots_other_day, slots_other_centre, selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start, selected_slot_label, slot_hold_id]
    SET:
      slot_outcome = "pending"
      slot_held = false
      readback_outcome = "pending"
      readback_confirmed = false
      same_day_request = false
      same_day_too_soon = false
      weekend_request = false
      requested_day_free = false
      search_centre_id = selected_centre_id
      contact_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(contact_mobile, caller_phone)
    CHECK: safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: when_clock

  # E82, E83, C3: today's date, weekday and time in the UAE come from the calendar, not from
  # the model. They are read before every day or time the caller says is worked out.
  when_clock:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_local_date_time
      AS: local_now
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: local_now.date IS SET AND local_now.date != ""
        SET:
          today_date = local_now.date
          today_weekday = local_now.weekday
          now_time = local_now.time
        THEN: when_ask
      - ELSE:
        THEN: system_down
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # E78, E82, E83: what the caller says becomes a date and a time window. E80: a weekend.
  # C3: today, and whether it is under 2 hours. Q12: a walk-in question is noted, not offered.
  when_ask:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Find out when the caller wants to bring the car to {{selected_centre_name}} and turn it into exact values.
      Today in the UAE is {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}, and the time now is {{now_time}}. Work out every date and weekday from this and from nothing else.
      {{#if said_when}}The caller has already said: {{said_when}}.{{/if}}
      {{#if requested_holiday.centres_closed}}The day asked for before, {{requested_holiday.date}}, is a public holiday and the centres are closed: say so and ask for another day.{{/if}}
      - They name a weekday and today is that weekday: ask "today, or next Thursday the 8th?" with the real weekday and date, before going on.
      - "After work", "tomorrow morning" and the like: turn it into a time window. An exact time such as "at 2" is a window that starts and ends at that time.
      - A weekend with no day named: take Sunday, with the Saturday of that weekend as the other day, and set weekend_request to true. If Sunday is closed at this centre, take that Saturday instead. If they ask for a Sunday, the other day is also that Saturday when it is still ahead; then set weekend_request to true as well.
      - No preference, or as soon as possible: take tomorrow with no time window. Take today only if they ask for today.
      - Today: set same_day_request to true. Per current policy a same-day booking needs a free time at least 2 hours ahead; if they want to come sooner than that, also set same_day_too_soon to true.
      - If they ask whether they can just walk in: say you will look for a booked time first so the centre expects them, and set walk_in_asked to true.
      Sunday opening for this centre: {{chosen_centre.open_sunday}}. Treat Sunday as closed unless this says true.
      Then set requested_date (YYYY-MM-DD), window_start and window_end (HH:MM, 24-hour; leave both unset if they gave no time), fallback_date (the next day the centre is open after requested_date, or the other weekend day) and search_until_date (14 days after requested_date). Keep what they asked for, in their words, in said_when.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: (requested_date IS SET AND fallback_date IS SET AND search_until_date IS SET) OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_TURNS: 4
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: structured_value
    THEN: when_gate

  when_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_date IS SET AND fallback_date IS SET AND search_until_date IS SET AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: holiday_check

  # N02: the holiday list is checked before any slot is searched or offered.
  holiday_check:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: get_public_holidays
      WITH:
        from_date: requested_date
        to_date: search_until_date
      AS: holiday_list
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: holiday_list.holidays IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          holidays_checked = true
          holidays_found = holiday_list.holidays
        THEN: holiday_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # N02: a day on which the centres are closed is not searched: the caller is asked for another.
  holiday_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      requested_holiday = ARRAY_FIND(holidays_found, "date", requested_date)
    THEN: holiday_closed_gate

  holiday_closed_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: requested_holiday.centres_closed == true
    ON_FAIL: slot_search
    THEN: holiday_closed

  holiday_closed:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [said_when]
    THEN: when_start

  # E78: the live slots for what the caller asked. E83: the window.
  # OPEN K06 (contact centre): Is this still right? Days on which a centre does not take smart
  # repair, polish, detailing or tint are left out by the slot search itself (job_type): it is
  # centre data, not a rule in this file.
  slot_search:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_service_slots
      WITH:
        centre_id: selected_centre_id
        date: requested_date
        window_start: window_start
        window_end: window_end
        service_code: service_code
        express: express_requested
        job_type: job_capability
      AS: preferred_slots
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: preferred_slots.total IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - IF: preferred_slots.total > 0
        SET:
          slots_wanted = preferred_slots.slots
        THEN: slot_offer
      - IF: window_start IS SET AND window_start != ""
        THEN: slot_search_day
      # E80: a weekend keeps the other weekend day as the other day to try.
      - IF: weekend_request == true
        THEN: slot_search_other_day
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          fallback_date = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(preferred_slots.next_available_date, fallback_date)
        THEN: slot_search_other_day
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # E79, Q05 option 1: the nearest time that day, at most three, nearest first.
  slot_search_day:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_service_slots
      WITH:
        centre_id: selected_centre_id
        date: requested_date
        service_code: service_code
        express: express_requested
        job_type: job_capability
        near_time: window_start
        limit: 3
      AS: same_day_slots
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: same_day_slots.total IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - IF: same_day_slots.total > 0
        SET:
          requested_day_free = true
          slots_that_day = same_day_slots.slots
        THEN: slot_search_other_day
      - IF: weekend_request == true
        THEN: slot_search_other_day
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          fallback_date = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(same_day_slots.next_available_date, fallback_date)
        THEN: slot_search_other_day
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # E79, Q05 option 2: another day. E80: Saturday when Sunday is full.
  slot_search_other_day:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_service_slots
      WITH:
        centre_id: selected_centre_id
        date: fallback_date
        service_code: service_code
        express: express_requested
        job_type: job_capability
        near_time: window_start
        limit: 3
      AS: other_day_slots
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: other_day_slots.total IS NOT SET
        THEN: system_down
      - IF: other_centre.centre_id IS SET AND other_centre.centre_id != selected_centre_id
        SET:
          slots_other_day = other_day_slots.slots
        THEN: slot_search_other_centre
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          slots_other_day = other_day_slots.slots
        THEN: same_day_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: system_down

  # E79, Q05 option 3: another centre that can do the job. C3: any branch with a free slot today.
  slot_search_other_centre:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: search_service_slots
      WITH:
        centre_id: other_centre.centre_id
        date: requested_date
        service_code: service_code
        express: express_requested
        job_type: job_capability
        near_time: window_start
        limit: 3
      AS: other_centre_slots
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: other_centre_slots.total > 0
        SET:
          requested_day_free = true
          slots_other_centre = other_centre_slots.slots
        THEN: same_day_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: same_day_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: same_day_gate

  # C3: the branch is emailed in every same-day outcome, each by its own step: no free time
  # today at any branch searched (same_day_no_slot_note), booked for today
  # (same_day_booked_note), under 2 hours with a walk-in suggested (same_day_walk_in_note).
  # The email is a note for the branch: the call carries on whether or not it is delivered.
  same_day_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_type = "same_day_no_slot"
    CHECK: same_day_request == true AND requested_day_free != true AND same_day_too_soon != true AND contact_mobile IS SET AND contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: slot_offer
    THEN: same_day_no_slot_note

  same_day_no_slot_note:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_team_request
      WITH:
        team: "service_centre"
        request_type: request_type
        summary: "A caller asked the voice assistant for a service today and no free time was found today at the centres checked on the call. Other days are being offered on the call."
        customer_mobile: contact_mobile
        centre_id: selected_centre_id
        customer_name: FIRST_NON_EMPTY(booking_contact_name, caller_name, customer_name)
        plate_number: plate_number
        callback_requested: false
      AS: same_day_note
    ON_RESULT:
      - ELSE:
        THEN: slot_offer
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: slot_offer

  # E78: the time is said as "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm". E83: the first slot in the window.
  # E79, Q05: when it is not free, up to 3 options in order: nearest time that day, another day,
  # another centre, plus early key drop or pick-up and drop-off. Q12: no walk-in offered here.
  slot_offer:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Offer the caller a time at {{selected_centre_name}} from the live results below only. Never invent a time. Say a time as its start_label gives it, in the form "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm".
      They asked for {{requested_date}}{{#if window_start}}, between {{window_start}} and {{window_end}}{{/if}}.
      Free in what they asked for (nothing when this is empty): {{slots_wanted | json}}
      {{#if slots_that_day}}Other free times that day, nearest first: {{slots_that_day | json}}{{/if}}
      {{#if slots_other_day}}Free on another day, {{fallback_date}}: {{slots_other_day | json}}{{/if}}
      {{#if slots_other_centre}}Free that day at another centre, {{other_centre.name}}: {{slots_other_centre | json}}{{/if}}
      Public holidays and closing days in this period: {{holidays_found | json}}. Never offer a day on which the centres are closed.
      {{#if slot_research_count}}The time picked before was just taken by someone else: say so in a few words and offer again.{{/if}}
      {{#if same_day_too_soon}}They wanted to come within two hours. Per current policy a same-day booking needs at least 2 hours' notice, so say that and offer the earliest times listed.{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq job_capability "smart_repair")}}Smart repair, polish, detailing and tint are not taken on every day at every centre. When the day they asked for shows no free time, say there is no time for this job on that day at this centre and offer the other days.{{/if}}
      - If they asked for an exact time and that exact time is free, do not ask again and say nothing: take it as picked. The read-back that follows tells them, as "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm".
      - If they gave a window or only a day and there are free times in it, offer the first one and wait for their answer.
      - If it is not free, offer up to 3 options in this order: the nearest time that day, then another day, then another centre. You may add that an early key drop (only if this centre has key drop: {{chosen_centre.key_drop}}) or pick-up and drop-off (only if this centre has it: {{chosen_centre.pickup_dropoff}}) can make a time work.
      - Do not offer a walk-in here. If they ask about walking in, say a booked time comes first and set walk_in_asked to true.
      Set slot_outcome:
      "picked": they accept a time. Set selected_slot_id to the slot_id of that time, exactly as in the results. Nothing else is needed: the centre and the time are taken from the results.
      "new_request": they ask for a day or time that is not in the results. Put what they asked for in said_when.
      "change_centre": they want a different service centre from the ones offered. Put the centre or place they named in said_place.
      "not_soon_enough": nothing offered is soon enough for them.
      "refused": they refuse every option for another reason.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: slot_outcome != "pending" OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 6
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: slot_route_1

  slot_route_1:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_outcome == "picked" AND selected_slot_id IS SET AND selected_slot_id != "" AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: slot_route_2
    THEN: slot_pick_resolve

  slot_route_2:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_outcome == "new_request"
    ON_FAIL: slot_route_centre
    THEN: when_start

  # E86 at the slot offer: a caller who asks for a different centre goes back to the centre step.
  slot_route_centre:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_outcome == "change_centre" AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: slot_route_3
    THEN: slot_change_centre

  slot_change_centre:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [selected_centre_id, selected_centre_name, alternate_centre_id]
    SET:
      slot_outcome = "pending"
    THEN: centre_talk

  slot_route_3:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_outcome == "not_soon_enough" AND same_day_too_soon != true AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: slot_route_4
    THEN: widen_gate

  slot_route_4:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: (slot_outcome == "refused" OR slot_outcome == "not_soon_enough") AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_stuck
    THEN: refused_gate

  # E78: the slot the caller picked is looked up in the live results, so the start time and
  # the words it is read back in come from the booking system and not from the model. A slot
  # from the other centre's list moves the booking to that centre.
  slot_pick_resolve:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      picked_wanted = ARRAY_FIND(slots_wanted, "slot_id", selected_slot_id)
      picked_that_day = ARRAY_FIND(slots_that_day, "slot_id", selected_slot_id)
      picked_other_day = ARRAY_FIND(slots_other_day, "slot_id", selected_slot_id)
      picked_other_centre = ARRAY_FIND(slots_other_centre, "slot_id", selected_slot_id)
    THEN: slot_pick_own_gate

  slot_pick_own_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: picked_wanted.slot_id IS SET OR picked_that_day.slot_id IS SET OR picked_other_day.slot_id IS SET
    ON_FAIL: slot_pick_other_gate
    THEN: slot_pick_own

  slot_pick_own:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      selected_centre_id = search_centre_id
      selected_slot_start = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(picked_wanted.start_time, picked_that_day.start_time, picked_other_day.start_time)
      selected_slot_label = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(picked_wanted.start_label, picked_that_day.start_label, picked_other_day.start_label)
    THEN: slot_pick_centre

  slot_pick_other_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: picked_other_centre.slot_id IS SET
    ON_FAIL: slot_lost
    THEN: slot_pick_other

  slot_pick_other:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      selected_centre_id = other_centre.centre_id
      selected_slot_start = picked_other_centre.start_time
      selected_slot_label = picked_other_centre.start_label
    THEN: slot_pick_centre

  # E74: the centre of the picked slot must be on the list of centres that can do the job.
  slot_pick_centre:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      chosen_centre = ARRAY_FIND(capable_list, "centre_id", selected_centre_id)
    THEN: slot_pick_verify

  slot_pick_verify:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      selected_centre_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(chosen_centre.name, selected_centre_name)
    CHECK: chosen_centre.centre_id IS SET
    ON_FAIL: slot_lost
    THEN: slot_hold

  # E85: the slot is held as soon as it is picked. The hold id goes with the booking.
  slot_hold:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: hold_service_slot
      WITH:
        slot_id: selected_slot_id
        plate_number: plate_number
      AS: hold_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: hold_result.held == true
        SET:
          slot_held = true
          slot_hold_id = hold_result.hold_id
        THEN: readback_prep
      - ELSE:
        THEN: slot_lost
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: slot_lost

  # E85: the slot went: one more search (slot_research_count), then a person.
  slot_lost:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start, selected_slot_label, slot_hold_id, slots_wanted, slots_that_day, slots_other_day, slots_other_centre]
    SET:
      slot_research_count = ADD(slot_research_count, 1)
      slot_outcome = "pending"
      slot_held = false
      readback_outcome = "pending"
      readback_confirmed = false
      requested_day_free = false
      search_centre_id = selected_centre_id
    THEN: slot_lost_gate

  # The count is raised in the step before and tested here: after the one extra search the
  # next lost slot goes to a person.
  slot_lost_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_research_count < 2
    ON_FAIL: slot_lost_person
    THEN: slot_search

  slot_lost_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "slot_lost"
    THEN: person_brief

  # E84: nothing soon enough: the days and centres are widened once (widen_count), then a person.
  widen_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      widen_count = ADD(widen_count, 1)
      slot_outcome = "pending"
    THEN: widen_limit

  widen_limit:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: widen_count < 2
    ON_FAIL: no_slot_person
    THEN: widen_search

  widen_search:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Nothing soon enough suited the caller at {{selected_centre_name}}. Widen the search once: look at more days there and at the other centres that can do this job.
      Today in the UAE is {{today_weekday}}, {{today_date}}, and the time now is {{now_time}}.
      Use find_service_centres with capability "{{job_capability}}"{{#if vehicle_model}} and vehicle model "{{vehicle_model}}"{{/if}} for the other centres, and search_service_slots with job_type "{{job_capability}}"{{#if service_code}} and service code "{{service_code}}"{{/if}} for free times. Before offering a day outside {{requested_date}} to {{search_until_date}}, check it with get_public_holidays.
      Offer up to 3 of the soonest options, each said as its start_label gives it, with the centre name. Never invent a time or a centre, and do not offer a walk-in.
      If they accept one, set selected_slot_id, selected_slot_start and selected_slot_label exactly as slot_id, start_time and start_label are in the results, selected_centre_id and selected_centre_name for its centre, and slot_outcome to "picked".
      If nothing suits them this time either, set slot_outcome to "refused" and say nothing about what happens next.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [find_service_centres, search_service_slots, get_public_holidays]
    EXIT_WHEN: slot_outcome != "pending" OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true OR booking_declined == true
    MAX_TURNS: 8
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 5
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_person
    THEN: widen_verify

  # E74: a centre found by the wider search must also be on the capable list.
  widen_verify:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      chosen_centre = ARRAY_FIND(capable_list, "centre_id", selected_centre_id)
    THEN: widen_check

  widen_check:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: slot_outcome == "picked" AND selected_slot_id IS SET AND chosen_centre.centre_id IS SET AND safety_flag != true AND needs_person != true AND booking_declined != true
    ON_FAIL: stop_or_person
    THEN: widen_centre_name

  widen_centre_name:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      selected_centre_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(chosen_centre.name, selected_centre_name)
    THEN: slot_hold

  # E84: after the one wider search a person takes over, unless a handover is already pending
  # or the caller no longer wants to book.
  stop_or_person:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true
    ON_FAIL: no_slot_gate
    THEN: escape_go

  no_slot_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_declined == true
    ON_FAIL: no_slot_person
    THEN: after_car_gate

  no_slot_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "no_slot_suits"
    THEN: person_brief

  # Q05: every option refused. C3: when the caller wanted to come within 2 hours, a walk-in is
  # suggested and the branch is emailed; otherwise the branch is emailed and calls back.
  refused_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_team = "service_centre"
      request_type = "same_day_walk_in"
      request_needs_centre = true
    CHECK: same_day_too_soon == true AND contact_mobile IS SET AND contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: branch_callback
    THEN: same_day_walk_in_note

  same_day_walk_in_note:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_team_request
      WITH:
        team: "service_centre"
        request_type: request_type
        summary: "A caller wanted to bring the car for a service today within two hours, which is too close to book. The voice assistant offered later times, which did not suit, and suggested a walk-in."
        customer_mobile: contact_mobile
        centre_id: selected_centre_id
        customer_name: FIRST_NON_EMPTY(booking_contact_name, caller_name, customer_name)
        plate_number: plate_number
        callback_requested: false
      AS: same_day_note
    ON_RESULT:
      - ELSE:
        THEN: walk_in_tell
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: walk_in_tell

  branch_callback:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_type = "no_slot_callback"
    THEN: request_brief

  walk_in_tell:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "It's too close to book a time for today. You're welcome to walk in, but without a booking the centre can't promise a time."
    MESSAGE_KEY: same_day_walk_in
    THEN: after_car_gate

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Phase 6: read-back, booking, confirmation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # The name for the booking is the caller's own name when they gave one, otherwise the name
  # on the profile. E69: a concern that the safety check has dealt with goes to the centre.
  # The number for the message falls back to the calling number here as it does on entry
  # (start_ready), and again in when_start: a booking that waited while the caller asked
  # something else may be resumed with the supervisor's values applied again, and an empty
  # number among them must not make the read-back ask for a number that is known.
  readback_prep:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_contact_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(booking_contact_name, caller_name, customer_name)
      contact_mobile = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(contact_mobile, caller_phone)
      contact_last_digits = SUBSTRING(contact_mobile, SUB(LENGTH(contact_mobile), 3))
      readback_outcome = "pending"
      readback_confirmed = false
      concern_note = ""
      record_note = ""
      pudo_unavailable = false
      express_unavailable = false
    CHECK: safety_note IS SET AND safety_note != ""
    ON_FAIL: readback_pudo_gate
    THEN: readback_concern

  readback_concern:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      concern_note = JOIN(["Concern raised earlier on this call:", safety_note], " ")
    THEN: readback_pudo_gate

  # E75: pick-up and drop-off is only added where the centre has it.
  readback_pudo_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: pickup_dropoff == true AND chosen_centre.pickup_dropoff != true
    ON_FAIL: readback_express_gate
    THEN: readback_pudo_off

  readback_pudo_off:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      pickup_dropoff = false
      pudo_unavailable = true
    THEN: readback_express_gate

  # C5: express only for a regular service, and only at a centre that offers it.
  readback_express_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: express_requested == true AND (visit_type != "service" OR chosen_centre.express_service != true)
    ON_FAIL: readback_outside_gate
    THEN: readback_express_off

  readback_express_off:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      express_requested = false
      express_unavailable = true
    THEN: readback_outside_gate

  # E57: the regular service only: no other jobs go on the booking.
  readback_outside_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: regular_service_only == true
    ON_FAIL: readback_record_gate
    THEN: readback_outside

  readback_outside:
    REASONING: false
    CLEAR: [extra_jobs]
    THEN: readback_record_gate

  # K12a (the identity agent's case): a car that is not yet in the caller's name is booked
  # with that fact and the car details in the notes for the centre.
  readback_record_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: vehicle_record_status == "not_in_callers_name"
    ON_FAIL: readback
    THEN: readback_record_note

  readback_record_note:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      record_note = JOIN(["The car is not yet in the caller's name; the owner change is still to be done at the centre. Car:", plate_number, vehicle_model], " ")
    THEN: readback

  # E78, E86, N24: car, service, centre, day and time are read back; nothing is booked before
  # a clear yes. E54, E89: no email.
  # OPEN Q08 (Aftersales workshop): Should the AI agent send confirmations and locations by
  # WhatsApp or SMS? Interim: the confirmation SMS goes to the registered number after its last
  # digits are confirmed here, or to another number; the channels are set where the messages
  # are sent (confirm_channel_gate and the steps after it).
  readback:
    REASONING: true
    GOAL: |
      Read the booking back and get a clear yes before anything is booked. Keep it to two short sentences: the booking, then where the confirmation message goes together with the one question whether to book it.
      {{#if vehicle_model}}{{vehicle_model}}, {{/if}}plate {{plate_number}}, for {{service_label}}{{#if extra_jobs}} with these jobs added: {{extra_jobs | json}}{{/if}}, at {{selected_centre_name}}, on {{selected_slot_label}}. Give exactly this day and time, in the form "Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm".{{#if pickup_dropoff}} With pick-up and drop-off.{{/if}}
      {{#if pudo_unavailable}}The caller asked for pick-up and drop-off, but this centre does not have it: say so before the read-back.{{/if}}
      {{#if express_unavailable}}The caller asked for express service. It is only for a regular service at a centre that offers it, so this visit is not booked as express: say so before the read-back. If they want a centre that offers express service instead, set job_capability to "express", express_requested to true and readback_outcome to "change_centre".{{/if}}
      {{#if (eq visit_type "job_only")}}If no job is listed above, ask which job they want done and add it to extra_jobs before you ask for the yes.{{/if}}
      Then say the confirmation message goes to the number ending {{contact_last_digits}}. If no digits are shown here, ask for the mobile number for the message, read it back in full in groups, and set contact_mobile once they say yes.
      Name for the booking: "{{booking_contact_name}}". If it is empty, ask for the name first and set booking_contact_name.
      - A clear yes: set readback_outcome to "confirmed" and say nothing. The booking is made after this step and the next steps tell the caller the outcome.
      - Another number for the message: take it, read the whole number back in groups, and after their yes set contact_mobile to it in international format. Then carry on.
      - They change the day or time: put the new wish in said_when and set readback_outcome to "change_time".
      - They change the centre: put it in said_place and set readback_outcome to "change_centre".
      - They add a job to the visit: add it to extra_jobs, say it is added without a price, and carry on.
      - They change what is booked: set readback_outcome to "change_service".
      - They no longer want to book: set booking_declined to true and say nothing: the next step tells them that nothing has been booked.
      - They ask for the confirmation by email or start to spell an email address: there is no email on this call; the message has a link to add the booking to the calendar, reschedule, cancel or track it.
      {{#if regular_service_only}}Only the regular service can be booked for this car: do not add other jobs.{{/if}}
      Set call_language to "en" or "ar", the language the caller is speaking.
    AVAILABLE_TOOLS: [search_toyota_knowledge]
    EXIT_WHEN: readback_outcome != "pending" OR booking_declined == true OR safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true
    MAX_ATTEMPTS: 4
    ON_EXHAUSTED: stop_or_stuck
    VOICE:
      END_OF_SPEECH_TURN_TYPE: simple_confirmation
    THEN: router_gate

  # The caller said yes, but the booking still has no name or no number for the message, and
  # it cannot be made without both. The read-back asks for what is missing once more; a second
  # yes without it goes to a person, so the same question is never repeated without end (each
  # return to the read-back starts its own count of tries afresh).
  readback_missing:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      readback_bounces = ADD(readback_bounces, 1)
    THEN: readback_missing_gate

  readback_missing_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: readback_bounces < 2
    ON_FAIL: readback_missing_person
    THEN: readback_prep

  readback_missing_person:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_details_missing"
    THEN: person_brief

  # A booking made for the owner carries the caller's own name as the person who booked it.
  commit_for_owner:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booked_for_owner = true
      booked_by_name = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(caller_name, "")
    THEN: commit_create

  # N01: the booking is tried at most twice (create_attempts); between the tries commit_verify
  # checks whether the first one went through.
  # E69: the notes carry the job note, the caller's concern and a concern the safety check has
  # dealt with (and, for a car not yet in the caller's name, that fact). E66, P03: the mileage status goes with the booking and the booking system
  # writes the No Mileage or Unsure KM note. E76: preferred advisor. E77: waits at the centre.
  # E75: pick-up and drop-off. N16: jobs. C5: express. Q10: the recall.
  # A refusal by the booking system is a normal result with a reason: a slot that went leads
  # to one more search (E85); a booking that is not allowed goes to a person.
  commit_create:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      create_attempts = ADD(create_attempts, 1)
    CALL: create_service_booking
      WITH:
        slot_id: selected_slot_id
        plate_number: plate_number
        contact_name: booking_contact_name
        contact_mobile: contact_mobile
        service_code: service_code
        visit_type: booking_visit_type
        recall_ids: recall_ids_to_book
        hold_id: slot_hold_id
        customer_id: crm_customer_id
        vehicle_id: vehicle_id
        current_km: current_km
        mileage_status: booking_mileage
        notes: TRIM(JOIN([job_note, caller_notes, concern_note, record_note], " "))
        extra_jobs: extra_jobs
        express: express_requested
        preferred_advisor: preferred_advisor
        pickup_dropoff: pickup_dropoff
        pickup_address: pickup_address
        customer_waits: customer_waits
        booked_for_owner: booked_for_owner
        booked_by_name: booked_by_name
      AS: booking_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: booking_result.booked == true
        SET:
          booking_created = true
          booking_reference = booking_result.booking_reference
          selected_slot_label = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(booking_result.start_label, selected_slot_label)
        THEN: booked_ok
      - IF: booking_result.failure_reason == "slot_taken" OR booking_result.failure_reason == "hold_expired"
        THEN: slot_lost
      - IF: booking_result.failure_reason == "not_allowed" OR booking_result.failure_reason == "validation"
        THEN: commit_refused
      - ELSE:
        SET:
          create_errored = false
        THEN: commit_verify
    ON_FAILURE:
      SET:
        create_errored = true
      THEN: commit_verify

  commit_refused:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_refused"
    THEN: person_brief

  # N01: checks whether the booking went through before trying again, so it never books twice.
  # After an error there is one more try; still failing: a person.
  commit_verify:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: find_service_bookings
      WITH:
        plate_number: plate_number
      AS: existing_bookings
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: existing_bookings.total IS NOT SET
        THEN: commit_failed
      - IF: existing_bookings.total > 0
        THEN: commit_match
      - IF: create_errored == true AND create_attempts < 2
        THEN: commit_create
      - ELSE:
        THEN: commit_failed
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: commit_failed

  commit_failed:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      handover_reason = "booking_failed"
    THEN: person_brief

  # N01: a booking for this car at the chosen time and centre is ours: it went through. Any
  # other booking for this car is told to the caller instead (E52), and no second one is made.
  commit_match:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      own_booking = ARRAY_FIND(existing_bookings.bookings, "start_time", selected_slot_start)
      existing_outcome = "pending"
      readback_outcome = "pending"
    THEN: commit_own_gate

  commit_own_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: own_booking.booking_reference IS SET AND own_booking.centre_id == selected_centre_id
    ON_FAIL: existing_gate
    THEN: commit_found

  commit_found:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      booking_reference = own_booking.booking_reference
      booking_created = true
    THEN: booked_ok

  # The booking is made. E70: the car is no longer settled for the supervisor, so the next
  # booking request on this call asks which car.
  # C3: a booking for today is always emailed to the branch. It is for today when the booked
  # time is on today's date (start_time begins with the date).
  booked_ok:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      car_settled = false
      slot_day = SUBSTRING(selected_slot_start, 0, 10)
      request_type = "same_day_booking"
    THEN: booked_today_gate

  booked_today_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: today_date IS SET AND slot_day == today_date AND contact_mobile IS SET AND contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: confirm_channel_gate
    THEN: same_day_booked_note

  same_day_booked_note:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_team_request
      WITH:
        team: "service_centre"
        request_type: request_type
        summary: "The voice assistant has booked a service for today at the caller's request. The booking reference is attached."
        customer_mobile: contact_mobile
        centre_id: selected_centre_id
        customer_name: booking_contact_name
        plate_number: plate_number
        booking_reference: booking_reference
        callback_requested: false
      AS: same_day_note
    ON_RESULT:
      - ELSE:
        THEN: confirm_channel_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: confirm_channel_gate

  # Q08 (open, see the read-back step): the confirmation goes by SMS to the number confirmed
  # at the read-back; with the flag set to whatsapp it goes by WhatsApp first and SMS is the
  # backup. E54, E89: the message carries the link; no email, ever.
  # The last three digits are spaced here, so that the fixed lines that follow say them one by
  # one and not as one number (the same form the identity agent uses); when the number does
  # not end in three digits, its last three characters are kept as before.
  confirm_channel_gate:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      contact_last_digits = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(TRIM(REGEX_REPLACE(COALESCE(REGEX_EXTRACT(contact_mobile, "[0-9]{3}$"), ""), "([0-9])", "$1 ")), SUBSTRING(contact_mobile, SUB(LENGTH(contact_mobile), 3)))
      confirmation_sent = false
      location_sent = false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_BOOKING_CONFIRMATION_CHANNEL}}" == "whatsapp")
    ON_FAIL: sms_send
    THEN: confirm_whatsapp

  confirm_whatsapp:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_customer_message
      WITH:
        mobile_number: contact_mobile
        template: "service_booking_confirmation"
        channel: "whatsapp"
        reference: booking_reference
        reference_type: "booking"
        language: call_language
      AS: sms_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: sms_result.sent == true
        SET:
          confirmation_sent = true
        THEN: location_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: sms_send
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: sms_send

  # Q08, E88: the confirmation SMS; the same step sends it again when it did not arrive.
  sms_send:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_customer_message
      WITH:
        mobile_number: contact_mobile
        template: "service_booking_confirmation"
        channel: "sms"
        reference: booking_reference
        reference_type: "booking"
        language: call_language
      AS: sms_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: sms_result.sent == true
        SET:
          confirmation_sent = true
        THEN: location_gate
      - ELSE:
        THEN: location_gate
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: location_gate

  # Q08: the centre's location and hours by message, only when the caller asked for it: by
  # WhatsApp with SMS as the backup, or by SMS only when the flag says sms.
  location_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: location_requested == true AND selected_centre_id IS SET AND selected_centre_id != ""
    ON_FAIL: booked_tell
    THEN: location_channel_gate

  location_channel_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_LOCATIONS_MESSAGE_CHANNEL}}" == "sms")
    ON_FAIL: location_send
    THEN: location_send_sms

  location_send:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_customer_message
      WITH:
        mobile_number: contact_mobile
        template: "location_and_hours"
        channel: "whatsapp"
        reference: selected_centre_id
        reference_type: "service_centre"
        language: call_language
      AS: location_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: location_result.sent == true
        SET:
          location_sent = true
        THEN: booked_tell
      - ELSE:
        THEN: location_send_sms
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: location_send_sms

  location_send_sms:
    REASONING: false
    CALL: send_customer_message
      WITH:
        mobile_number: contact_mobile
        template: "location_and_hours"
        channel: "sms"
        reference: selected_centre_id
        reference_type: "service_centre"
        language: call_language
      AS: location_result
    ON_RESULT:
      - IF: location_result.sent == true
        SET:
          location_sent = true
        THEN: booked_tell
      - ELSE:
        THEN: booked_tell
    ON_FAILURE:
      THEN: booked_tell

  # The booking was read back in full before the yes (E78); what follows is its outcome, in
  # fixed lines: the caller never hears "booked" or "sent" unless the booking system and the
  # message service said so, and the closing line always comes last.
  # E88: the read-back is the backup if the message does not arrive. E54, E89: the message
  # carries the link; no email.
  booked_tell:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: booking_created == true
    ON_FAIL: resend_tell_gate
    THEN: booked_line_gate

  # E121 (demo overlay, journey 09): at the AI Summit a booking is called a demonstration booking.
  booked_line_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: ("{{env.TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE}}" == "true")
    ON_FAIL: booked_line
    THEN: booked_line_demo

  booked_line:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "That's booked, just as I read it out."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_done
    THEN: confirmation_line_gate

  booked_line_demo:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "That's your demonstration booking, just as I read it out."
    MESSAGE_KEY: booking_done_demo
    THEN: confirmation_line_gate

  confirmation_line_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: confirmation_sent == true
    ON_FAIL: confirmation_failed_line
    THEN: confirmation_line

  confirmation_line:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I've sent the confirmation to the number ending {{contact_last_digits}}, with a link to add it to your calendar, reschedule, cancel or track it."
    MESSAGE_KEY: confirmation_message_sent
    THEN: location_line_gate

  confirmation_failed_line:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "The confirmation message couldn't be sent just now, but your booking stands."
    MESSAGE_KEY: confirmation_message_failed
    THEN: location_line_gate

  # E88: the confirmation of a booking that already existed, sent again.
  resend_tell_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: confirmation_sent == true
    ON_FAIL: confirmation_failed_line
    THEN: resend_line

  resend_line:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I've sent the confirmation again to the number ending {{contact_last_digits}}."
    MESSAGE_KEY: confirmation_message_resent
    THEN: location_line_gate

  # Q08: the centre's location and hours, when the caller asked for them by message.
  location_line_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: location_requested == true
    ON_FAIL: after_car_gate
    THEN: location_sent_gate

  location_sent_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: location_sent == true
    ON_FAIL: location_failed_line
    THEN: location_line

  location_line:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I've also sent you the centre's location and opening hours."
    MESSAGE_KEY: centre_location_sent
    THEN: after_car_gate

  location_failed_line:
    REASONING: false
    RESPOND: "I couldn't send the centre's location just now."
    MESSAGE_KEY: centre_location_failed
    THEN: after_car_gate

  # The work on this car is finished (booked, kept, declined or passed to a team). The turn
  # is closed by one of the two fixed steps below, and only when no handover is pending.
  after_car_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: safety_flag == true OR needs_person == true
    ON_FAIL: price_declined_gate
    THEN: escape_go

  # E68 (the service questions agent's case; the same rule on the booking path): a caller who
  # asked the price, was given it and then does not book: the branch is emailed. The email
  # needs a service centre: the one chosen on this call, otherwise the centre of the last
  # visit. Without one, or when the email cannot be sent, the call simply closes.
  price_declined_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: price_known == true AND booking_declined == true AND booking_created != true AND another_car_pending != true AND contact_mobile IS SET AND contact_mobile != ""
    ON_FAIL: declined_line_gate
    THEN: price_declined_centre

  price_declined_centre:
    REASONING: false
    SET:
      request_type = "price_enquiry_not_booked"
      price_note_centre = FIRST_NON_EMPTY(selected_centre_id, last_centre_id, "")
    THEN: price_declined_centre_gate

  price_declined_centre_gate:
    REASONING: false
    CHECK: price_note_centre IS SET AND price_note_centre != ""
    ON_FAIL: price_declined_lookup_gate
    THEN: price_declined_note

  price_declined_lookup_gate:
    REASONING: false
